title: Co-Director: Agentic Generative Video Storytelling
summary: While diffusion models generate high-fidelity video clips, transforming them into coherent storytelling engines remains challenging. Current agentic pipelines automate this via chained modules but suffer from semantic drift and cascading failures due to independent, handcrafted prompting. We present Co-Director, a hierarchical multi-agent framework formalizing video storytelling as a global optimization problem. To ensure semantic coherence, we introduce hierarchical parameterization: a multi-armed bandit globally identifies promising creative directions, while a local multimodal self-refinement loop mitigates identity drift and ensures sequence-level consistency. This balances the exploration of novel narrative strategies with the exploitation of effective creative configurations. For evaluation, we introduce GenAD-Bench, a 400-scenario dataset of fictional products for personalized advertising. Experiments demonstrate that Co-Director significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, offering a principled approach that seamlessly generalizes to broader cinematic narratives. Project Page: https://co-director-agent.github.io/

AI.tldr: Co-Director是一个层次化多智能体框架，将视频故事生成形式化为全局优化问题，通过多臂老虎机进行全局创意方向探索、局部多模态自 refining 循环确保一致性，在虚构产品广告数据集GenAD-Bench上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散模型虽能生成高保真视频片段，但将其转化为连贯的故事引擎仍然困难。现有自动化管线依赖独立的手工提示链式模块，存在语义漂移和级联失败问题。
AI.method: 提出Co-Director层次化多智能体框架：(1) 层次化参数化——多臂老虎机全局识别有潜力的创意方向；(2) 局部多模态自 refining 循环——缓解身份漂移并确保序列级一致性。平衡新颖叙事策略的探索与有效创意配置的利用。
AI.result: 在自建的400场景虚构产品广告数据集GenAD-Bench上，Co-Director显著优于现有最佳基线方法，并能无缝泛化到更广泛的电影叙事。
AI.conclusion: Co-Director提供了一种原则性的视频故事生成方法，有效解决了语义一致性问题，可泛化到多种叙事场景。
idea_en: Hierarchical multi-agent framework for video storytelling as global optimization
Multi-armed bandit for global creative direction identification in video generation
Local multimodal self-refinement loop for identity drift mitigation in sequential video
Hierarchical parameterization balancing exploration and exploitation in narrative generation
GenAD-Bench: 400-scenario fictional product dataset for personalized advertising video evaluation

采用多臂老虎机算法在视频生成中全局识别最有潜力创意方向的技术

title: Latent Agents: A Post-Training Procedure for Internalized Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate has been shown to improve reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, it is compute-intensive, requiring generation of long transcripts before answering questions. To address this inefficiency, we develop a framework that distills multi-agent debate into a single LLM through a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline combining debate structure learning with internalization via dynamic reward scheduling and length clipping. Across multiple models and benchmarks, our internalized models match or exceed explicit multi-agent debate performance using up to 93% fewer tokens. We then investigate the mechanistic basis of this capability through activation steering, finding that internalization creates agent-specific subspaces: interpretable directions in activation space corresponding to different agent perspectives. We further demonstrate a practical application: by instilling malicious agents into the LLM through internalized debate, then applying negative steering to suppress them, we show that distillation makes harmful behaviors easier to localize and control with smaller reductions in general performance compared to steering base models. Our findings offer a new perspective for understanding multi-agent capabilities in distilled models and provide practical guidelines for controlling internalized reasoning behaviors. Code available at https://github.com/johnsk95/latent_agents

AI.tldr: 提出一种将多智能体辩论蒸馏到单个LLM的框架，通过两阶段微调管道结合辩论结构学习与内部化，在减少93% token的同时达到或超越显式多智能体辩论效果，并揭示了内部化创建的智能体特定子空间及其在有害行为控制中的应用。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论能提升LLM推理能力，但计算开销大，需要生成长文本后才能回答问题，效率低下。
AI.method: 两阶段微调管道：(1)辩论结构学习；(2)通过动态奖励调度和长度裁剪实现内部化。
AI.result: 内部化模型使用减少93%的token，匹配或超越显式多智能体辩论的性能；内部化创建了智能体特定子空间；通过负向激活引导可更有效地控制和定位有害行为。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏使多智能体能力更易定位和控制，为理解蒸馏模型中的多智能体能力提供了新视角，并为控制内部化推理行为提供了实用指南。
idea_en: A two-stage fine-tuning pipeline for distilling multi-agent debate into a single LLM, comprising debate structure learning followed by internalization via dynamic reward scheduling and length clipping.
Activation steering method to identify and manipulate agent-specific subspaces in the activation space of a distilled LLM, enabling interpretable control over different agent perspectives.

Negative steering technique applied to internalized debate models to suppress malicious agent behaviors, achieving better harm localization and control with smaller general performance degradation compared to steering base models.
Dynamic reward scheduling mechanism for training LLMs to internalize multi-agent debate structures efficiently.
Length clipping strategy in conjunction with reward scheduling to reduce token usage while preserving multi-agent reasoning quality.
idea_ch: 一种两阶段微调管道，将多智能体辩论蒸馏到单个LLM中，包括辩论结构学习和通过动态奖励调度与长度裁剪实现的内部化。
激活引导方法，用于识别和操控蒸馏LLM激活空间中智能体特定子空间，实现对不同智能体视角的可解释控制。
负向引导技术应用于内部化辩论模型，以抑制恶意智能体行为，相比引导基础模型，实现了更好的危害定位和控制，且通用性能下降更小。
动态奖励调度机制，用于高效训练LLM内部化多智能体辩论结构。
结合奖励调度的长度裁剪策略，在减少token使用量的同时保持多智能体推理质量。

title: S-SONDO: Self-Supervised Knowledge Distillation for General Audio Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at IEEE ICASSP 2026. 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Equal contribution by first two authors. Code: https://github.com/MedAliAdlouni/ssondo | Models: https://huggingface.co/mohammedali2501/ssondo | Package: https://pypi.org/project/ssondo/
summary: General audio foundation models have recently achieved remarkable progress, enabling strong performance across diverse tasks. However, state-of-the-art models remain extremely large, often with hundreds of millions of parameters, leading to high inference costs and limited deployability on edge devices. Knowledge distillation is a proven strategy for model compression, but prior work in audio has mostly focused on supervised settings, relying on class logits, intermediate features, or architecture-specific techniques. Such assumptions exclude models that output only embeddings, such as self-supervised or metric-learning models. We introduce S-SONDO (Self-Supervised KnOwledge DistillatioN for General AuDio FOundation Models), the first framework to distill general audio models using only their output embeddings. By avoiding the need for logits or layer-level alignment, S-SONDO is architecture-agnostic and broadly applicable to embedding-based teachers. We demonstrate its effectiveness by distilling two audio foundation models into three efficient students that are up to 61 times smaller while retaining up to 96% of teacher performance. We also provide practical insights on loss choice and clustering-based balanced data sampling. Code is available here: https://github.com/MedAliAdlouni/ssondo.

AI.tldr: S-SONDO 是首个仅利用输出嵌入对通用音频基础模型进行自监督知识蒸馏的框架，可将模型压缩至原大小的1/61，同时保留高达96%的教师模型性能，且无需类别logits或中间层特征，具有架构无关性。
AI.motivation: 现有音频基础模型虽性能优异但参数量巨大（数亿级），导致推理成本高、难以部署到边缘设备。先前的知识蒸馏方法多依赖监督设置下的类别logits、中间特征或特定架构技术，不适用于仅输出嵌入的自监督或度量学习模型。
AI.method: 提出 S-SONDO 框架，仅利用教师模型的输出嵌入对学生模型进行蒸馏，无需logits或层级别对齐。通过设计合适的蒸馏损失函数和基于聚类的均衡数据采样策略，实现架构无关的模型压缩。
AI.result: 将两个音频基础模型蒸馏为三个高效学生模型，学生模型体积比教师模型小至61倍，同时保留高达96%的教师模型性能。
AI.conclusion: S-SONDO 是首个仅依赖输出嵌入的通用音频模型蒸馏框架，具有架构无关性，为大规模音频基础模型在资源受限设备上的部署提供了可行方案。
idea_en: Self-supervised knowledge distillation framework using only output embeddings from teacher model, applicable to any embedding-based audio foundation models without requiring logits or intermediate layer access.
Architecture-agnostic distillation method that decouples teacher and student model architectures, enabling compression of diverse audio models into efficient students.
Clustering-based balanced data sampling strategy for knowledge distillation in embedding space, improving representation learning for self-supervised audio models.
Loss function design specifically optimized for embedding-based distillation in self-supervised audio settings, enabling effective knowledge transfer without class labels.
Method for compressing general audio foundation models by up to 61x while retaining 96% of teacher performance, enabling deployment on edge devices.
idea_ch: 一种仅利用教师模型输出嵌入进行自监督知识蒸馏的框架，无需类别logits或中间层特征，适用于任何基于嵌入的音频基础模型。
架构无关的蒸馏方法，解耦教师模型与学生模型的架构，将多种音频模型压缩为高效学生模型。
基于聚类的均衡数据采样策略，用于嵌入空间中的知识蒸馏，提升自监督音频模型的表示学习效果。
针对自监督音频嵌入蒸馏优化的损失函数设计，无需类别标签即可实现有效的知识迁移。
通用音频基础模型压缩方法，最高将模型缩小61倍同时保留96%的教师性能，支持边缘设备部署。

title: Adaptive Prompt Embedding Optimization for LLM Jailbreaking
summary: Existing white-box jailbreak attacks against aligned LLMs typically append discrete adversarial suffixes to the user prompt, which visibly alters the prompt and operates in a combinatorial token space. Prior work has avoided directly optimizing the embeddings of the original prompt tokens, presumably because perturbing them risks destroying the prompt's semantic content. We propose Prompt Embedding Optimization (PEO), a multi-round white-box jailbreak that directly optimizes the embeddings of the original prompt tokens without appending any adversarial tokens, and show that the concern is unfounded: the optimized embeddings remain close enough to their originals that the visible prompt string is preserved exactly after nearest-token projection, and quantitative analysis shows the model's responses stay on topic for the large majority of prompts. PEO combines continuous embedding-space optimization with structured continuation targets and an adaptive failure-focused schedule. Counterintuitively, later PEO rounds can benefit from heuristic composite response scaffolds that are not natural standalone templates, yet ASR-Judge shows that the resulting gains are not merely empty formatting or scaffold-only outputs. Across two standard harmful-behavior benchmarks and competing white-box attacks spanning discrete suffix search, appended adversarial embeddings, and search-based adversarial generation, PEO outperforms all of them in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出PEO方法，直接优化原始提示词嵌入而非添加对抗后缀，实现白盒越狱攻击，在保持原文本语义和可见性的同时取得更好攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 现有白盒越狱攻击依赖添加离散对抗后缀，改变提示词可见形式且搜索空间大；直接优化原始嵌入被认为会破坏语义。本文旨在验证直接优化嵌入的可行性与有效性。
AI.method: PEO是一个多轮白盒越狱方法：(1) 直接优化原始提示词token的嵌入向量；(2) 结合连续嵌入空间优化与结构化续接目标；(3) 自适应失败聚焦调度策略；(4) 使用启发式复合响应支架（composite response scaffolds）辅助后续轮次。
AI.result: 在两个标准有害行为基准测试中，PEO优于所有对比的白盒攻击方法（包括离散后缀搜索、附加对抗嵌入、搜索式对抗生成），且优化后的嵌入经过最近邻投影后保持原始提示文本不变，模型回答基本保持话题相关性。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化原始提示嵌入是可行且有效的越狱攻击方法，打破了"优化嵌入会破坏语义"的直觉，攻击性能优于现有方法且保持提示文本不变。
idea_en: A multi-round white-box jailbreak method that directly optimizes the embeddings of original prompt tokens without appending any adversarial tokens, ensuring the visible prompt string remains unchanged after nearest-token projection.
An adaptive failure-focused scheduling strategy that dynamically allocates optimization rounds based on previous failures, increasing attack efficiency against aligned LLMs.

Heuristic composite response scaffolds for later optimization rounds that combine multiple response structures, where gains are verified not to be merely empty formatting or scaffold-only outputs via specialized judge evaluation.
Continuous embedding-space optimization combined with structured continuation targets, enabling effective jailbreak while maintaining the original prompt's semantic content intact.
A method demonstrating that perturbed prompt embeddings remain close enough to originals after optimization, preserving both the visible string and topic relevance in model responses.
idea_ch: 一种多轮白盒越狱方法，直接优化原始提示词token的嵌入向量而非附加对抗token，经最近邻投影后保持可见提示字符串不变
自适应失败聚焦调度策略，根据之前的失败情况动态分配优化轮次，提高对对齐LLM的攻击效率
针对后续优化轮次的启发式复合响应支架，组合多种响应结构，通过专门判别器验证收益并非仅来自空格式或支架本身
结合连续嵌入空间优化与结构化续接目标的方法，在保持原始提示语义完整的同时实现有效越狱
一种证明优化后扰动嵌入仍与原始嵌入足够接近的方法，同时保持可见字符串不变和模型回答的话题相关性

title: Assessing Y-Axis Influence: Bias in Multimodal Language Models on Chart-to-Table Translation
summary: Chart-to-table translation converts chart images into structured tabular data. Accurate translation is crucial for Multimodal Language Model (MLM) to answer complex queries. We observe imbalances in the number of images across different aspects of the y-axis information in public chart datasets. Such imbalances can introduce unintended biases, causing uneven MLM performance. Previous works have not systematically examined these biases. To address this gap, we propose a new framework, FairChart2Table, for analyzing y-axis-related bias on five state-of-the-art models. Key Findings: (1) There are significant y-axis biases related to the digit length of the major tick values, the number of major ticks, the range of values, and the tick value format (e.g., abbreviation or scientific format). (2) The number of legends/entities in chart images impacts MLM performance. (3) Prompting MLM with y-axis information can significantly enhance the performance for some MLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出FairChart2Table框架，系统分析图表转表格任务中y轴信息相关的数据偏差，发现刻度值数字长度、刻度数量、数值范围、刻度格式等因素会引入偏差，影响多模态大模型性能，并验证了加入y轴提示可提升部分模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有图表转表格数据集中各维度样本分布不均，导致模型性能不均衡，而以往研究未系统分析此类偏差。
AI.method: 提出FairChart2Table框架，对五种主流模型进行y轴相关偏差的系统分析。
AI.result: 发现刻度值数字长度、主刻度数量、数值范围、刻度格式（缩写/科学计数法）存在显著偏差；图例/实体数量影响性能；加入y轴提示可提升部分模型表现。
AI.conclusion: 图表转表格任务中存在y轴信息偏差问题，需在数据收集和模型设计中加以关注和缓解。
idea_en: A bias-aware data balancing method for chart-to-table training datasets that actively rebalances samples across y-axis digit length, tick count, value range, and tick format dimensions to reduce unintended model biases.

A prompt engineering technique that automatically extracts and injects y-axis metadata (e.g., tick format, range, digit length) into the input prompt of Multimodal Language Models to improve chart-to-table translation accuracy.

A fairness evaluation framework (FairChart2Table) that systematically measures y-axis-related performance disparities across different MLMs, enabling standardized bias auditing for chart understanding tasks.

A chart data augmentation method that synthetically generates diverse y-axis configurations (varying tick digit lengths, numbering formats, and tick counts) to create more balanced training distributions.
idea_ch: 一种感知偏差的图表转表格训练数据平衡方法，通过主动平衡y轴数字长度、刻度数量、数值范围和刻度格式等维度的样本分布，减少非预期的模型偏差。
一种提示工程技术，自动提取y轴元数据（如刻度格式、范围、数字长度）并注入多模态大语言模型的输入提示中，以提升图表转表格的翻译精度。
一种公平性评估框架（FairChart2Table），系统度量不同多模态大模型在y轴相关维度上的性能差异，为图表理解任务的标准化偏差审计提供工具。
一种图表数据增强方法，通过合成生成多样化的y轴配置（变化刻度数字长度、编号格式和刻度数量），创建更均衡的训练数据分布。

title: Sparse Personalized Text Generation with Multi-Trajectory Reasoning
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance, personalization has become a key mechanism for tailoring outputs to individual user needs. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dense interaction histories, making them ineffective in cold-start scenarios where such data is sparse or unavailable. While external signals (e.g., content of similar users) can offer a potential remedy, leveraging them effectively remains challenging: raw context is often noisy, and existing methods struggle to reason over heterogeneous data sources. To address these issues, we introduce PAT (Personalization with Aligned Trajectories), a reasoning framework for cold-start LLM personalization. PAT first retrieves information along two complementary trajectories: writing-style cues from stylistically similar users and topic-specific context from preference-aligned users. It then employs a reinforcement learning-based, iterative dual-reasoning mechanism that enables the LLM to jointly refine and integrate these signals. Experimental results across real-world personalization benchmarks show that PAT consistently improves generation quality and alignment under sparse-data conditions, establishing a strong solution to the cold-start personalization problem.

AI.tldr: 提出PAT框架，通过双轨迹检索（风格相似用户的写作线索+偏好相似用户的主题上下文）和强化学习迭代双推理机制，解决LLM在冷启动场景下的个性化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法依赖密集交互历史，在冷启动场景（数据稀疏或缺失）下效果差；外部信号（相似用户内容）虽可补救但原始信息噪声大，且现有方法难以推理异构数据源。
AI.method: 1) 双轨迹检索：从风格相似用户提取写作风格线索，从偏好相似用户提取主题上下文；2) 基于强化学习的迭代双推理机制，让LLM联合精炼并整合两种信号。
AI.result: 在真实个性化基准测试中，PAT在稀疏数据条件下持续提升了生成质量和用户对齐度。
AI.conclusion: PAT为冷启动个性化问题提供了强有效的解决方案，验证了双轨迹检索+强化学习推理的有效性。
idea_en: A dual-trajectory retrieval method for cold-start LLM personalization that separately retrieves writing-style cues from stylistically similar users and topic-specific context from preference-aligned users.
A reinforcement learning-based iterative dual-reasoning mechanism that enables LLMs to jointly refine and integrate heterogeneous personalization signals from multiple user trajectories.
A cold-start personalization framework that uses aligned user trajectories to compensate for sparse or missing interaction history data.
A method combining stylistic similarity retrieval and preference-aligned retrieval to extract complementary personalization signals for LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种面向冷启动LLM个性化的双轨迹检索方法，分别从风格相似用户检索写作风格线索和从偏好对齐用户检索主题上下文。
一种基于强化学习的迭代双推理机制，使LLM能够联合精炼并整合来自多条用户轨迹的异构个性化信号。
一种利用对齐用户轨迹补偿稀疏或缺失交互历史数据的冷启动个性化框架。
一种结合风格相似检索和偏好对齐检索的方法，为LLM提取互补的个性化信号。

title: Toward a Science of Intent: Closure Gaps and Delegation Envelopes for Open-World AI Agents
summary: Recent work has framed intelligence in verifiable tasks as reducing time-to-solution through learned structure and test-time search, while systems work has explored learned runtimes in which computation, memory and I/O migrate into model state. These perspectives do not explain why capable models remain difficult to deploy in open institutions. We propose intent compilation: the transformation of partially specified human purpose into inspectable artifacts that bind execution. The relevant deployment distinction is closed-world solver versus open-world agent. In closed worlds, a checker is largely given; in open worlds, verification is distributed across semantic, evidentiary, procedural and institutional dimensions. Weformalize this residual openness as a closure-gap vector, define delegation envelopes as pre-authorized regions of action space, distinguish misclosure from undersearch, and outline benchmark metrics for testing when closure interventions outperform additional inference-time search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"意图编译"概念，将人类部分指定的目的转化为可检查的工件，并定义了闭世界求解器与开放世界代理之间的关键区别，形式化了"闭合缺口向量"、委托信封等概念，为开放世界中的AI部署提供了理论框架。
AI.motivation: 当前智能系统虽有强大能力，但在开放机构中部署仍然困难，现有关于可验证任务和系统运行时的视角无法解释这一困境，需要新的理论框架来理解闭世界与开放世界的部署差异。
AI.method: 提出意图编译（intent compilation）框架，形式化定义闭合缺口向量（closure-gap vector）、委托信封（delegation envelopes），区分错误闭合（misclosure）与欠搜索（undersearch），并设计基准指标测试闭合干预与额外推理搜索的效果对比。
AI.result: 建立了开放世界部署的理论框架，明确了闭世界求解器与开放世界代理的核心区别，提供了评估闭合干预效果的具体指标。
AI.conclusion: 意图编译为开放世界中AI系统的可验证部署提供了新路径，强调闭合干预比单纯增加推理搜索更能解决开放性问题。
idea_en: Intent Compilation Framework: A method for transforming partially specified human purpose into inspectable artifacts that bind execution, enabling verification across semantic, evidentiary, procedural and institutional dimensions.

Closure-Gap Vector Formalization: A mathematical formalism that quantifies residual openness in deployment environments, distinguishing between closed-world solvers and open-world agents based on multi-dimensional verification requirements.

Delegation Envelope Mechanism: A pre-authorized region of action space that defines safe operational boundaries for AI agents in open-world settings, enabling controlled delegation while maintaining verifiability.

title: Leverage Laws: A Per-Task Framework for Human-Agent Collaboration
summary: We propose a per-task leverage ratio for human-agent collaboration: human work displaced by an agent, divided by the human time required to specify the task, resolve mid-run interrupts, and review the result. The denominator decomposes into three channels through which a conserved per-task information requirement must flow, each with its own time-cost scalar. We show that information density itself is directional and bounded by separate ceilings on human-to-agent and agent-to-human flow, and that the asymptotic behavior of leverage decomposes into two scaling axes (capability and memory) with a non-zero floor on the planning term set by irreducible task novelty bounded by human throughput. We extend this per-task analysis to a windowed leverage measure that accommodates recurring tasks, spawned subtasks, and amortized system-design investment. The per-task ceiling does not bind the windowed measure, though both remain bounded: $L_{\text{task}}$ by per-task novelty, $L_{\text{window}}$ by the stock of accumulated planning investment that pays out within the window. The framework operationalizes aspects of earlier qualitative work on supervisory control (Sheridan, 1992), common ground (Clark & Brennan, 1991), and mixed-initiative interaction (Horvitz, 1999) within a single normative ratio, and produces a list of testable empirical questions that we leave as open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了人机协作中的每任务杠杆率，量化人类被智能体替代的工作量与任务描述、运行中断处理和结果审查所需人类时间之比，并分析了信息密度方向性、缩放轴（能力与记忆）以及窗口化杠杆率扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有的人机协作缺乏统一的量化框架来衡量智能体对人类工作的替代效率，无法准确评估不同协作模式下的杠杆效果。
AI.method: 提出了一个每任务杠杆率公式，将人类时间分解为任务指定、运行中断处理、结果审查三个通道，分析了信息密度的方向性和边界，并扩展到窗口化杠杆率以处理重复任务和系统设计投资。
AI.result: 每任务杠杆率受每任务新颖性限制，窗口化杠杆率受积累的规划投资存量限制；信息密度具有方向性且受人类到智能体和智能体到人类两个方向的上限约束。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将监督控制、共同基础和混合主动交互等定性概念统一在单一规范化比率中，并提出了可测试的开放性实证问题。

A windowed leverage measure that extends per-task analysis to recurring tasks, spawned subtasks, and amortized system-design investments across time windows.

title: Evaluating Risks in Weak-to-Strong Alignment: A Bias-Variance Perspective
summary: Weak-to-strong alignment offers a promising route to scalable supervision, but it can fail when a strong model becomes confidently wrong on examples that lie in the weak teacher's blind spots. Understanding such failures requires going beyond aggregate accuracy, since weak-to-strong errors depend not only on whether the strong model disagrees with its teacher, but also on how confidence and uncertainty are distributed across examples. In this work, we analyze weak-to-strong alignment through a bias-variance-covariance lens that connects misfit theory to practical post-training pipelines. We derive a misfit-based upper bound on weak-to-strong population risk and study its empirical components using continuous confidence scores. We evaluate four weak-to-strong pipelines spanning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) on the PKU-SafeRLHF and HH-RLHF datasets. Using a blind-spot deception metric that isolates cases where the strong model is confidently wrong while the weak model is uncertain, we find that strong-model variance is the strongest empirical predictor of deception across our settings. Covariance provides additional but weaker information, indicating that weak-strong dependence matters, but does not by itself explain the observed failures. These results suggest that strong-model variance can serve as an early-warning signal for weak-to-strong deception, while blind-spot evaluation helps distinguish whether failures are inherited from weak supervision or arise in regions of weak-model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过偏差-方差-协方差分析框架研究弱到强对齐中的盲点欺骗问题，发现强模型方差是欺骗行为的最强预测因子，协方差提供额外但较弱的信息，盲点评估有助于区分失败是继承自弱监督还是源于弱模型的不确定性区域。
AI.motivation: 弱到强对齐在强模型对弱教师盲点示例变得自信错误时会失败，需要超越聚合精度理解这种失败机制，分析置信度和不确定性在不同示例上的分布。
AI.method: 采用偏差-方差-协方差分析框架，推导基于失配的弱到强总体风险上界，使用连续置信度分数研究经验成分，在PKU-SafeRLHF和HH-RLHF数据集上评估四种弱到强管线（SFT、RLHF、RLAIF），并设计盲点欺骗度量指标。
AI.result: 强模型方差是跨设置的欺骗行为最强经验预测因子；协方差提供额外但较弱的信息，表明弱-强依赖关系存在但不足以解释观察到的失败。
AI.conclusion: 强模型方差可作为弱到强欺骗的早期预警信号，盲点评估有助于区分失败是继承自弱监督还是出现在弱模型不确定性区域。
idea_en: A method for detecting weak-to-strong alignment deception by monitoring strong model variance as an early-warning signal, enabling early intervention before alignment failures occur.
A blind-spot deception metric that isolates cases where a strong model is confidently wrong while a weak teacher model is uncertain, providing a quantitative measure for evaluating alignment quality.
A bias-variance-covariance decomposition framework for analyzing weak-to-strong alignment, enabling systematic identification of failure modes in scalable supervision pipelines.
A continuous confidence score-based approach for estimating weak-to-strong population risk upper bounds, facilitating real-time monitoring of alignment quality without requiring ground truth labels.
A method for distinguishing whether alignment failures are inherited from weak supervision or originate from regions of weak model uncertainty through blind-spot evaluation.

title: Agentic Architect: An Agentic AI Framework for Architecture Design Exploration and Optimization
summary:
Rapid advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) create new opportunities by enabling efficient exploration of broad, complex design spaces. This is particularly valuable in computer architecture, where performance depends on microarchitectural designs and policies drawn from vast combinatorial spaces.
  We introduce Agentic Architect, an agentic AI framework for computer architecture design exploration and optimization that combines LLM-driven code evolution with cycle-accurate simulation. The human architect specifies the optimization target, seed design, scoring function, simulator interface, and benchmark split, while the LLM explores implementations within these constraints. Across cache replacement, data prefetching, and branch prediction, Agentic Architect matches or exceeds state-of-the-art designs. Our best evolved cache replacement design achieves a 1.062x geomean IPC speedup over LRU, 0.6% over Mockingjay (1.056x). Our evolved branch predictor achieves a 1.100x geomean IPC speedup over Bimodal, 1.5% over its Hashed Perceptron seed (1.085x). Finally, our evolved prefetcher achieves a 1.76x geomean IPC speedup over no prefetching, 17% over its VA/AMPM Lite seed (1.59x) and 21% over SMS (1.55x).
  Our analysis surfaces several findings about agentic AI-driven microarchitecture design. Across evolved designs, components often correspond to known techniques; the novelty lies in how they are coordinated. The architect's role is shifting, but the human remains central. Seed quality bounds what search can achieve: evolution can refine and extend an existing mechanism, but cannot compensate for a weak foundation. Likewise, objectives, constraints, and prompt guidance affect reliability and generalization. Overall, Agentic Architect is the first end-to-end open-source framework for agentic AI architecture exploration and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Architect，一种基于智能体AI的计算机架构设计探索与优化框架，通过LLM驱动的代码进化与周期精确仿真结合，在缓存替换、数据预取和分支预测任务上达到或超越当前最优设计。
AI.motivation: 计算机架构设计中存在庞大的组合优化空间，传统人工探索效率低下，而LLM的快速进展为自动化探索复杂设计空间提供了新机遇。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Architect框架：人类架构师指定优化目标、种子设计、评分函数、仿真器接口和基准测试集，LLM在约束条件下通过代码进化（生成、评估、迭代）与周期精确仿真器结合，自动探索实现微架构设计。
AI.result: 缓存替换设计：比LRU提升1.062x IPC，比Mockingjay提升0.6%；分支预测器：比Bimodal提升1.100x IPC，比哈希感知器种子提升1.5%；预取器：比无预取提升1.76x IPC，比种子提升17%，比SMS提升21%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体AI可自动发现与已知技术对应的组件，创新点在于组件间的协调方式；种子设计质量决定搜索上限；人类架构师角色转变但仍保持核心地位；目标是首个端到端开源智能体AI架构探索框架。

title: Cooperate to Compete: Strategic Coordination in Multi-Agent Conquest
summary: Language Model (LM)-based agents remain largely untested in mixed-motive settings where agents must leverage short-term cooperation for long-term competitive goals (e.g., multi-party politics). We introduce Cooperate to Compete (C2C), a multi-agent environment where players can engage in private negotiations while competing to be the first to achieve their secret objective. Players have asymmetric objectives and negotiations are non-binding, allowing alliances to form and break as players' short-term interests align and diverge. We run AI only games and conduct a user study pitting human players against AI opponents. We identify significant differences between human and AI negotiation behaviors, finding that humans favor lower-complexity deals and are significantly less reliable partners compared to LM-based agents. We also find that humans are more aggressive negotiators, accepting deals without a counteroffer only 56.3% of the time compared to 67.6% for LM-based agents. Through targeted prompting inspired by these findings, we modify agents' negotiation behavior and improve win rates from 22.2% to 32.7%. We run over 1,100 games with over 16,000 private conversations totaling 15.2 million tokens and over 150,000 player actions. Our results establish C2C as a testbed for studying and building LM-based agents that can navigate the sophisticated coordination required for real-world deployments. The game, code, and dataset may be found at https://negotiationgame.io/c2c.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C2C（Cooperate to Compete）多智能体环境，研究LM基智能体在混合动机场景（短期合作、长期竞争）中的表现。通过AI-only游戏和真人实验，发现人类与AI谈判行为存在显著差异，并通过针对性提示将AI胜率从22.2%提升至32.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有LM基智能体在纯合作或纯竞争场景中已有研究，但在混合动机场景（如多党政治）中，智能体需要利用短期合作实现长期竞争目标，这一领域尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 构建C2C多智能体环境，玩家可通过私人谈判竞争，但谈判不具约束力；进行AI-only游戏和真人用户研究，对比人类与LM基智能体的谈判行为；基于发现的差异设计针对性提示，改进智能体谈判策略。
AI.result: 人类偏好低复杂度交易，作为合作伙伴可靠性显著低于LM基智能体；人类谈判更激进，仅56.3%接受无还价交易（LM为67.6%）；通过针对性提示，AI胜率从22.2%提升至32.7%。
AI.conclusion: C2C可作为研究LM基智能体在复杂协调场景中行为的测试平台，有助于构建能应对真实世界部署的智能体。

title: Doing More With Less: Revisiting the Effectiveness of LLM Pruning for Test-Time Scaling
summary: While current Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities through test-time compute scaling (TTS), their massive parameter counts and high inference costs have motivated the development of pruning methods that can reduce model size without sacrificing performance. However, specific to reasoning LLMs, prior work has shown that structured pruning (methods which removes entire set of layer blocks), significantly degrades TTS reasoning performance. In this work, we revisit this assumption and instead investigate whether unstructured pruning (methods that carefully remove only certain redundant/detrimental weights) exhibits similar limitations. Surprisingly, our extensive experiments across four reasoning benchmarks on two reasoning LLMs: s1.1-7B and Qwen3-8B, consistently show that unstructured pruning augments TTS performance compared to structured pruning, and at times can even outperform the unpruned full-weight LLMs. Furthermore, we also empirically study the impact of different layer-wise sparsity allocation strategies, which are an important parametric choice for instantiating unstructured pruning methods. These findings challenge the conventional notion that pruning always reduces TTS performance and in fact, suggest that carefully undertaken pruning can improve TTS effectiveness even further.

AI.tldr: 本文发现非结构化剪枝（移除冗余权重）能够增强推理型大语言模型的测试时计算扩展（TTS）性能，甚至超越未剪枝的全权重模型，挑战了"剪枝必然降低TTS性能"的传统认知。
AI.motivation: 推理型大语言模型参数庞大、推理成本高，结构化剪枝会严重损害TTS推理性能，因此需要探索非结构化剪枝对TTS性能的影响。
AI.method: 在s1.1-7B和Qwen3-8B两个推理型LLM上，针对四个推理基准，对比结构化剪枝与非结构化剪枝的TTS性能，并研究不同层间稀疏度分配策略的影响。
AI.result: 非结构化剪枝始终优于结构化剪枝的TTS性能，有时甚至超过未剪枝的全权重模型；层间稀疏度分配策略对性能有重要影响。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的非结构化剪枝不仅不会降低TTS性能，反而能进一步提升推理效率，为推理型LLM的高效部署提供了新方向。
idea_en: A method for enhancing test-time compute scaling (TTS) performance in reasoning large language models through unstructured pruning that selectively removes redundant or detrimental weights rather than entire layer blocks.
A layer-wise sparsity allocation strategy for unstructured pruning of reasoning LLMs, where different layers receive different sparsity ratios to optimize TTS reasoning performance.
A pruning framework specifically designed for reasoning LLMs that combines unstructured weight removal with test-time compute scaling, capable of outperforming unpruned full-weight models.
A technique for improving inference efficiency of reasoning LLMs by applying unstructured pruning that paradoxically enhances rather than degrades TTS reasoning capabilities.

一种专为推理型大语言模型设计的剪枝框架，将非结构化权重移除与测试时计算扩展相结合，能够超越未剪枝的全权重模型性能。

title: Semantic Layers for Reliable LLM-Powered Data Analytics: A Paired Benchmark of Accuracy and Hallucination Across Three Frontier Models
summary: LLMs deployed for natural-language querying of analytical databases suffer from two intertwined failures - incorrect answers and confident hallucinations - both rooted in the same cause: the model is forced to infer business semantics that the schema does not encode. We test whether supplying those semantics as context closes the gap. We benchmark three frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4) on 100 natural-language questions over the Cleaned Contoso Retail Dataset in ClickHouse, using a paired single-shot protocol. Each model is evaluated twice: once given only the warehouse schema, and once given the schema plus a 4 KB hand-authored markdown document describing the dataset's measures, conventions, and disambiguation rules. Adding the document improves accuracy by +17 to +23 percentage points across all three models. With it, the three models are statistically indistinguishable (67.7-68.7%); without it, they are also indistinguishable (45.5-50.5%). Every cross-cluster comparison is significant at p < 0.01. The presence of the semantic-layer document accounts for essentially all of the significant variance; model choice within tier does not. We interpret this as a structural result: explicit business semantics suppress the dominant class of text-to-SQL errors not by making the model more capable, but by changing what the model is being asked to do.

AI.tldr: 在自然语言查询分析型数据库时，LLM的两个核心问题——错误答案和自信幻觉——源于模型被迫推断Schema未编码的业务语义。补充这些语义（4KB手写文档）可将准确率提升17-23个百分点，且模型间的差异被语义层文档的存在所主导，而非模型本身的选择。
AI.motivation: LLM在自然语言查询分析型数据库时存在两类交织的失败：错误答案和自信幻觉，根源在于模型被迫推断数据库Schema未编码的业务语义。本文旨在验证"提供显式的业务语义作为上下文"是否能够弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 在ClickHouse上的Cleaned Contoso Retail数据集上，使用配对的单次查询协议，对三个前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.7、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4）进行基准测试。每个模型分别在两种条件下评估：仅提供仓库Schema，以及提供Schema加4KB手写业务语义文档（包含度量、约定及消歧规则）。
AI.result: 添加业务语义文档后，三个模型的准确率均提升17-23个百分点。有文档时，模型准确率在67.7-68.7%之间，统计上无显著差异；无文档时，准确率在45.5-50.5%之间，也无显著差异。所有跨集群比较在p<0.01水平上显著。语义层文档的存在解释了几乎所有显著方差，而模型选择（在同层级内）无显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个结构性结果：显式的业务语义通过改变模型被要求完成的任务本身（而非使模型能力更强），从而抑制了text-to-SQL中的主导错误类别。准确率的提升并非来自模型能力增强，而是来自任务重构——将"推断隐含语义"转变为"查找显式规则"。
idea_en: A method for improving LLM-based natural language querying of analytical databases by providing a structured semantic layer document that encodes business measures, conventions, and disambiguation rules as context alongside the database schema.

A paired single-shot evaluation protocol for benchmarking LLM text-to-SQL performance that controls for the confounding effect of implicit business semantics by comparing schema-only vs. schema-plus-semantic-layer conditions.
A semantic-layer document architecture of approximately 4KB that captures domain-specific business knowledge to suppress hallucinations and incorrect answers in analytical database querying.
A system architecture where an explicit business semantics layer is injected into the LLM prompt context to transform the task from implicit semantic inference to explicit rule lookup.
A method for statistically isolating the effect of semantic context from model capability variance in text-to-SQL accuracy benchmarking across frontier LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种通过提供结构化语义层文档来改进LLM对分析型数据库自然语言查询的方法，该文档编码了业务度量、约定和消歧规则，作为数据库Schema的补充上下文。
一种配对式单次查询评估协议，通过比较仅Schema与Schema加语义层两种条件，控制隐式业务语义对LLM文本到SQL性能基准测试的混淆效应。
一种约4KB的语义层文档架构，捕获领域特定的业务知识，以抑制分析型数据库查询中的幻觉和错误答案。
一种系统架构，将显式业务语义层注入LLM提示上下文中，将任务从隐式语义推断转变为显式规则查找。
一种统计学方法，用于在前沿LLM的文本到SQL准确率基准测试中，将语义上下文效应与模型能力方差进行隔离分析。

title: Training Transformers as a Universal Computer
summary: We demonstrate that a small transformer can learn to execute programs in MicroPy, a simplified yet computationally universal programming language. Given procedure definitions together with an expression to evaluate, the transformer predicts small-step execution using PENCIL scaffolding for space-efficient execution within a bounded context window. After training on randomly generated, meaningless MicroPy programs, the learned transformer generalizes to various human-written programs including bit copying and flipping, binary addition and multiplication, and SAT verification and solving. We note that the trained model can achieve out-of-distribution generalization; i.e., evaluate novel programs from distribution on programs. Since MicroPy can express any computation, our results provide empirical evidence that a standard transformer can be trained to act as a universal computer.

AI.tldr: 本文证明小型Transformer可以通过PENCIL框架学习执行MicroPy通用编程语言，从随机生成的无意义程序训练后，能泛化到多种人类编写的程序，具备分布外泛化能力，为Transformer作为通用计算机提供了实证证据。
AI.motivation: 探索Transformer是否可以通过训练成为通用计算机，即能否学习执行任意计算，并实现分布外泛化。
AI.method: 使用MicroPy（简化但图灵完备的编程语言）生成随机无意义程序，采用PENCIL脚手架技术实现有限上下文窗口内的空间高效执行，训练小型Transformer模型进行小步执行预测。
AI.result: 训练后的Transformer不仅能正确执行随机程序，还能泛化到人类编写的各种程序（位拷贝、翻转、二进制加减法、乘法、SAT验证与求解），并展现出分布外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 标准Transformer可以通过训练成为通用计算机，具备执行任意计算任务的能力，验证了神经图灵完备性的可行性。
idea_en: PENCIL scaffolding method for space-efficient program execution within bounded context window in transformers
Training transformer on randomly generated meaningless programs to achieve generalization to human-written programs
Using MicroPy as intermediate representation for transformer-based program execution
Small-step execution prediction mechanism for program evaluation in transformer architectures
Out-of-distribution generalization technique for transformer-based program execution across different program distributions

通过随机生成无意义程序训练Transformer，使其泛化到人类编写程序的新型训练范式

在Transformer架构中实现小步执行预测的程序评估机制
跨不同程序分布实现Transformer程序执行的分布外泛化技术

title: From Insight to Action: A Novel Framework for Interpretability-Guided Data Selection in Large Language Models
summary: While mechanistic interpretability tools like Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) can uncover meaningful features within Large Language Models (LLMs), a critical gap remains in transforming these insights into practical actions for model optimization. We bridge this gap with the hypothesis that data selection guided by a model's internal task features is a effective training strategy. Inspired by this, we propose Interpretability-Guided Data Selection (IGDS), a framework that first identifies these causal task features through frequency recall and interventional filtering, then selects ``Feature-Resonant Data'' that maximally activates task features for fine-tuning. We validate IGDS on mathematical reasoning, summarization, and translation tasks within Gemma-2, LLaMA-3.1, and Qwen3 models. Our experiments demonstrate exceptional data efficiency: on the Math task, IGDS surpasses full-dataset fine-tuning by a remarkable 17.4% on Gemma-2-2B while using only 50% of the data, and outperforms established baselines focused on data quality and diversity. Analysis confirms a strong positive correlation between feature amplification and task performance improvement. IGDS thus provides a direct and effective framework to enhance LLMs by leveraging their internal mechanisms, validating our core hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IGDS框架，通过识别LLM内部因果任务特征并选择“特征共振数据”进行微调，显著提升数据效率。在数学推理任务中，仅用50%数据便超越全量数据微调17.4%。
AI.motivation: 可解释性工具（如SAE）能揭示LLM内部特征，但缺乏将这些洞见转化为模型优化实际操作的桥梁。作者假设：基于模型内部任务特征指导的数据选择是一种有效的训练策略。
AI.method: 1. 通过频率召回和干预过滤识别因果任务特征；2. 选择能最大程度激活任务特征的“特征共振数据”；3. 利用这些数据进行微调。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务中，Gemma-2-2B上仅用50%数据超越全量微调17.4%；在摘要和翻译任务上也表现优异；特征放大与任务性能提升呈强正相关。
AI.conclusion: IGDS提供了一个直接有效的框架，通过利用LLM内部机制来增强模型，验证了基于内部特征进行数据选择的核心假设。
idea_en: A data selection framework (IGDS) that identifies causal task features in LLMs via frequency recall and interventional filtering, then selects Feature-Resonant Data that maximally activates those features for fine-tuning.
A method of using mechanistic interpretability tools (e.g., SAEs) to guide training data selection, bridging the gap between model interpretability and practical model optimization.
A frequency recall and interventional filtering technique to identify task-specific causal features within LLMs, enabling precise feature isolation.
A feature-resonant data selection strategy that prioritizes training samples based on their activation strength on identified causal task features.
A framework demonstrating that feature amplification (measured via SAE) strongly correlates with task performance improvement, providing a validation metric for interpretability-guided training.
idea_ch: 一种通过频率召回和干预过滤识别LLM中因果任务特征、并选择最大化激活这些特征的"特征共振数据"进行微调的数据选择框架（IGDS）
一种利用机械可解释性工具（如稀疏自编码器SAE）指导训练数据选择的方法，弥合模型可解释性与实际模型优化之间的鸿沟

title: DATAREEL: Automated Data-Driven Video Story Generation with Animations
summary: Data videos are a powerful medium for visual data based storytelling, combining animated, chart-centric visualizations with synchronized narration. Widely used in journalism, education, and public communication, they help audiences understand complex data through clear and engaging visual explanations. Despite their growing impact, generating data-driven video stories remains challenging, as it requires careful coordination of visual encoding, temporal progression, and narration and substantial expertise in visualization design, animation, and video-editing tools. Recent advances in large language models offer new opportunities to automate this process; however, there is currently no benchmark for rigorously evaluating models on animated visualization-based video storytelling. To address this gap, we introduce DataReel, a benchmark for automated data-driven video story generation comprising 328 real-world stories. Each story pairs structured data, a chart visualization, and a narration transcript, enabling systematic evaluation of models' abilities to generate animated data video stories. We further propose a multi-agent framework that decomposes the task into planning, generation, and verification stages, mirroring key aspects of the human storytelling process. Experiments show that this multi-agent approach outperforms direct prompting baselines under both automatic and human evaluations, while revealing persistent challenges in coordinating animation, narration, and visual emphasis. We release DataReel at https://github.com/vis-nlp/DataReel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DataReel基准，包含328个真实世界的数据视频故事，用于评估AI模型自动生成数据驱动动画视频故事的能力，并提出了一种多智能体框架来分解规划、生成和验证阶段。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏一个标准化的基准来评估大语言模型在动画可视化视频故事讲述方面的能力，生成数据驱动的视频故事需要协调视觉编码、时间进度和旁白，仍需大量专业知识。
AI.method: 构建DataReel基准（328个真实故事，每个故事包含结构化数据、图表可视化和旁白文本），并提出一个多智能体框架，将任务分解为规划、生成和验证三个阶段。
AI.result: 多智能体方法在自动评估和人工评估中均优于直接提示基线方法，但在协调动画、旁白和视觉重点方面仍存在持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: DataReel为自动化数据视频故事生成提供了基准，多智能体框架展示了潜力，但动画、旁白和视觉强调的协调仍是待解决的关键问题。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework for automated data video story generation that decomposes the task into planning, generation, and verification stages, mimicking human storytelling workflow.

A benchmark (DataReel) comprising 328 real-world data video stories with paired structured data, chart visualization, and narration transcript for evaluating animated visualization-based video storytelling.
A method for systematically coordinating visual encoding, temporal progression, and synchronized narration in automated data video generation using LLMs.
An evaluation methodology combining automatic metrics and human evaluation for assessing multi-modal data video story generation quality.
idea_ch: 一种多智能体框架，将自动化数据视频故事生成任务分解为规划、生成和验证三个阶段，模拟人类讲故事的工作流程。
DataReel基准：包含328个真实世界数据视频故事，每个故事配对结构化数据、图表可视化和旁白文本，用于评估动画可视化视频故事讲述能力。
一种利用大语言模型在自动化数据视频生成中系统协调视觉编码、时间进度和同步旁白的方法。
一种结合自动评估指标和人工评估的多模态数据视频故事生成质量评估方法。

title: ValueAlpha: Agreement-Gated Stress Testing of LLM-Judged Investment Rationales Before Returns Are Observable
comment: 9 pages, Submitted to IEEE Computational Intelligence in Financial Engineering and Economics (CIFEr) 2026, Tokyo, Japan
summary:
Long-horizon investment decisions create a pre-realization evaluation problem: realized returns are the eventual arbiter of investment quality, but they arrive too late and are too noisy to guide many model-development and governance decisions. LLM judges offer a tempting substitute for pre-deployment evaluation of AI-finance systems, but unvalidated judges may reward verbosity, confidence, or rubric mimicry rather than financial judgment. This paper introduces \textbf{ValueAlpha}, a preregistered agreement-gated stress-test protocol for deciding when LLM-judged investment-rationale claims are publishable, qualified, or invalid.
  In a controlled market-state capital-allocation prototype with 1,000 honest decision cycles and 100 preregistered adversarial controls (1,100 trajectories, 5,500 judge calls), ValueAlpha clears the aggregate agreement gate at \(\barκ_w = 0.7168\) but prevents several overclaims. Lower-rank systems collapse into a tie-class, one rubric dimension fails the per-dimension gate (\texttt{constraint\_awareness}, \(\barκ_w = 0.2022\)), single-judge rankings are family-dependent, and terse-correct rationales receive a \(Δ= -2.81\) rubric-point penalty relative to honest rationales. A targeted anchor-specificity probe further shows that financial constructs such as constraint awareness are operationally load-bearing.
  The contribution is therefore not a leaderboard and not a claim to measure true investment skill. ValueAlpha is a pre-calibration metrology layer for AI-finance evaluation: it determines whether a proposed LLM-judge-based investment-rationale claim is stable enough, agreed enough, and uncontaminated enough to be reported at all.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ValueAlpha协议，一种预注册的、基于一致性的压力测试方法，用于评估LLM作为金融投资逻辑评判者的可靠性，防止未经验证的评判者奖励冗长、自信或模仿评分标准而非真正的金融判断。
AI.motivation: 长期投资决策面临"实现前评估困境"：已实现收益来得太晚且噪声太大，无法指导模型开发和治理决策。LLM评判者虽有诱惑力，但未经验证的评判可能奖励冗长、自信或模仿评分标准，而非真正的金融判断能力。
AI.method: 提出ValueAlpha协议，一个预注册的、基于一致性的压力测试协议。在受控市场状态资本配置原型中，使用1,000个诚实决策周期和100个预注册对抗控制（共1,100条轨迹，5,500次评判调用），通过聚合一致性门限（κ̄_w=0.7168）和多维度验证来评估LLM评判的可靠性。
AI.result: ValueAlpha通过了聚合一致性门限，但阻止了若干过度声明。低排名系统陷入平局类，约束意识维度未能通过门限（κ̄_w=0.2022），单评判者排名具有家族依赖性，简洁正确的推理相对于诚实推理受到-2.81分的评分惩罚。锚定特异性探测显示约束意识等金融构造在操作上是承重的。
AI.conclusion: ValueAlpha不是排行榜，也不是衡量真实投资能力的主张，而是一个用于AI金融评估的预校准计量层，用于判断基于LLM评判的投资逻辑声明是否足够稳定、一致且无污染，从而值得报告。
idea_en: Preregistered agreement-gated stress-test protocol (ValueAlpha) for validating LLM-based evaluation of AI-finance systems before deployment
Multi-dimensional rubric agreement gate mechanism that filters LLM judge outputs across multiple financial judgment dimensions
Adversarial control trajectories (100 preregistered adversarial scenarios) embedded in 1,000 honest decision cycles for stress-testing LLM judge reliability
Aggregate agreement gate (κ̄_w threshold) as a metrology layer for determining whether LLM-judged investment rationale claims are publishable
Anchor-specificity probe method for testing whether financial constructs (e.g., constraint awareness) are operationally load-bearing in LLM evaluation
Per-dimension agreement gate that independently validates each rubric dimension (e.g., constraint awareness dimension with κ̄_w=0.2022 threshold)
Terse-correct rationale penalty detection system that identifies systematic rubric-point penalties for concise accurate rationales vs verbose ones
Family-dependent ranking correction for single-judge rankings to account for evaluation dependency across families

title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery
summary: Autonomous scientific research is significantly advanced thanks to the development of AI agents. One key step in this process is finding the right scientific literature, whether to explore existing knowledge for a research problem, or to acquire evidence for verifying assumptions and supporting claims. To assess AI agents' capability in driving this process, we present AutoResearchBench, a dedicated benchmark for autonomous scientific literature discovery. AutoResearchBench consists of two complementary task types: (1) Deep Research, which requires tracking down a specific target paper through a progressive, multi-step probing process, and (2) Wide Research, which requires comprehensively collecting a set of papers satisfying given conditions. Compared to previous benchmarks on agentic web browsing, AutoResearchBench is distinguished along three dimensions: it is research-oriented, calling for in-depth comprehension of scientific concepts; literature-focused, demanding fine-grained utilization of detailed information; and open-ended, involving an unknown number of qualified papers and thus requiring deliberate reasoning and search throughout. These properties make AutoResearchBench uniquely suited for evaluating autonomous research capabilities, and extraordinarily challenging. Even the most powerful LLMs, despite having largely conquered general agentic web-browsing benchmarks such as BrowseComp, achieve only 9.39% accuracy on Deep Research and 9.31% IoU on Wide Research, while many other strong baselines fall below 5%. We publicly release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to facilitate future research in this direction. We publicly release the dataset, evaluation pipeline, and code at https://github.com/CherYou/AutoResearchBench.

AI.tldr: 提出了AutoResearchBench，一个用于评估AI agent在自主科学文献发现能力上的基准测试，包含Deep Research和Wide Research两种任务。实验表明，即使最强的大语言模型在该基准上也表现极差（准确率约9%），远低于在通用网页浏览基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有通用网页浏览基准无法充分评估AI agent在自主科学文献发现方面的能力，因为科学文献发现需要深入理解科学概念、精细利用详细信息以及开放式搜索。需要专门的基准来评估AI agent的自主科研能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含两个互补任务的基准：Deep Research（通过多步渐进式探查追踪特定目标论文）和Wide Research（全面收集满足给定条件的一组论文）。相比此前基准，该基准具有研究导向、文献聚焦和开放式的特点。
AI.result: 最强LLM在Deep Research上仅达9.39%准确率，在Wide Research上仅达9.31% IoU，多数基线低于5%。而同样的模型在通用网页浏览基准BrowseComp上已表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 自主科学文献发现对当前AI agent而言仍极具挑战性，AutoResearchBench为评估和提升AI自主科研能力提供了有价值的基准。
idea_en: A multi-step iterative probing method for autonomously tracking down a specific target scientific paper through progressive refinement of search queries based on partial information.

A comprehensive literature collection system that autonomously identifies a set of papers satisfying complex, multi-condition scientific criteria without knowing the total number of qualified papers in advance.
An evaluation framework combining accuracy-based metrics for targeted paper retrieval and IoU-based metrics for open-ended literature collection tasks.
A dual-task benchmarking methodology that separately assesses deep targeted searching ability and broad comprehensive collection ability in scientific literature discovery.

一种综合文献收集系统，能够在未知合格论文总数的情况下，自主识别满足复杂多条件科学标准的一组论文

title: Plausible but Wrong: A case study on Agentic Failures in Astrophysical Workflows
summary: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being integrated into scientific workflows, yet their behavior under realistic conditions remains insufficiently understood. We evaluate CMBAgent across two workflow paradigms and eighteen astrophysical tasks. In the One-Shot setting, access to domain-specific context yields an approximately ~6x performance improvement (0.85 vs. ~0 without context), with the primary failure mode being silent incorrect computation - syntactically valid code that produces plausible but inaccurate results. In the Deep Research setting, the system frequently exhibits silent failures across stress tests, producing physically inconsistent posteriors without self-diagnosis. Overall, performance is strong on well-specified tasks but degrades on problems designed to probe reasoning limits, often without visible error signals. These findings highlight that the most concerning failure mode in agentic scientific workflows is not overt failure, but confident generation of incorrect results. We release our evaluation framework to facilitate systematic reliability analysis of scientific AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了CMBAgent在天体物理任务中的表现，发现其在有领域上下文时性能提升约6倍，但最令人担忧的失败模式是"静默错误计算"——生成语法正确但结果不准确的代码，且在压力测试中系统无法自我诊断。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI系统正被越来越多地集成到科学工作流中，但它们在现实条件下的行为尚未得到充分理解，特别是失败模式尚不明确。

title: Multi-action Tangled Program Graphs for Multi-task Reinforcement Learning with Continuous Control
summary: Over the past few decades, machine learning has been widely used to learn complex tasks. Reinforcement Learning (RL), inspired by human behavior, is a great example, as it involves developing specific behaviours for specific tasks. To further challenge algorithms, Multi-Task RL (MTRL) environments have been introduced, requiring a single model to learn multiple behaviors. The Tangled Program Graph (TPG) algorithm is a Genetic Programming (GP) algorithm designed for discrete MTRL environments. Recently, the MAPLE algorithm has been proposed, as another GP algorithm that achieves high results in single task continuous RL environments. A variation of the TPG is proposed alongside MAPLE, named Multi-Action TPG (MATPG) that aggregates MAPLE agents, and creates a control flow to activate them. Initially tested on single task RL environments only, MATPG achieved similar results to MAPLE. In this work, we present a new benchmark based on the MuJoCo Half Cheetah from Gymnasium. This benchmark features five distinct obstacles that are randomly positioned in front of the agent, each of which demands a unique behavior. This benchmark serves as a use case for MATPG, to prove its ability as a GP solution for continuous MTRL environments. Our experiments demonstrate its superiority in this multi-task use case when combined with lexicase selection. Furthermore, we examine the interpretability of the evolved graph, revealing that the decision flow of the model is fully interpretable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于MuJoCo Half Cheetah的多障碍物连续多任务强化学习基准，并验证了Multi-Action TPG（MATPG）算法结合lexicase选择在该场景下的优越性及完全可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有TPG算法主要针对离散MTRL环境，而MAPLE虽在单任务连续RL中表现出色，但缺乏面向连续MTRL的有效GP解决方案。需要验证MATPG在连续多任务场景中的能力。
AI.method: 1) 设计了基于MuJoCo Half Cheetah的五种随机障碍物基准，每种障碍物要求不同行为策略；2) 将MATPG（多动作TPG）应用于该连续MTRL基准；3) 结合lexicase选择进行优化，并分析进化图的可解释性。
AI.result: MATPG结合lexicase选择在连续多任务基准中表现出优越性，且进化图的决策流完全可解释。
AI.conclusion: MATPG是连续MTRL环境的有效GP解决方案，兼具高性能和可解释性。
idea_en: A multi-action tangled program graph (MATPG) architecture that aggregates multiple MAPLE agents with a control flow mechanism for activating different agents based on environmental context in continuous multi-task RL environments.

A benchmark system for continuous multi-task reinforcement learning using MuJoCo Half Cheetah with five distinct randomly positioned obstacles, each requiring unique obstacle-specific learned behaviors.
Integration of lexicase selection with MATPG for improved performance in continuous multi-task RL scenarios.
A fully interpretable decision flow mechanism in evolved program graphs for multi-task continuous RL, enabling transparent model reasoning.

title: JURY-RL: Votes Propose, Proofs Dispose for Label-Free RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances the reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but standard RLVR often depends on human-annotated answers or carefully curated reward specifications. In machine-checkable domains, label-free alternatives such as majority voting or LLM-as-a-judge remove annotation cost but can introduce false positives that destabilize training. We introduce JURY-RL, a label-free RLVR framework that decouples answer proposal from reward disposal: votes from model rollouts propose a candidate answer, and a formal verifier determines whether that candidate can receive positive reward. Concretely, only rollouts matching the plurality-voted answer are rewarded when that answer is successfully verified in Lean. When verification is inconclusive, we invoke ResZero (Residual-Zero), a fallback reward that discards the unverified plurality proposal and redistributes a zero-mean, variance-preserving signal over the residual answers. This design maintains a stable optimization gradient without reinforcing unverifiable consensus. Across three backbone models trained on mathematical data, JURY-RL consistently outperforms other label-free baselines on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and transfers competitively to code generation and general benchmarks. It attains pass@1 performance comparable to supervised ground-truth training, with superior generalization demonstrated by higher pass@k and response diversity.

AI.tldr: JURY-RL提出了一种无标签的RLVR方法，通过解耦答案提议与奖励分配：模型rollouts投票产生候选答案，Lean形式验证器决定是否给予奖励。当验证不确定时，使用ResZero回退奖励机制保持稳定梯度，在数学推理、代码生成等任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 标准RLVR依赖人工标注答案或精心设计的奖励规范，成本高且易出错。无标签替代方案（如多数投票或LLM评判）虽去除了标注成本，但可能引入假阳性，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 1. 解耦答案提议与奖励分配：模型rollouts投票产生候选答案（答案提议），Lean形式验证器决定是否给予奖励（奖励分配）。2. 只有匹配多数票答案的rollouts在通过Lean验证后才能获得正奖励。3. 当验证不确定时，使用ResZero回退奖励：丢弃未经验证的多数提议，在剩余答案上重新分配零均值、方差保持的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在三个骨干模型上的数学数据训练中，JURY-RL在数学推理基准上持续优于其他无标签基线，在代码生成和通用基准上具有竞争力，达到了与监督式真实标签训练相当的pass@1性能，并展现出更高的pass@k和响应多样性。
AI.conclusion: JURY-RL通过形式验证与自适应奖励分配机制，在无人工标注条件下实现了稳定高效的强化学习训练，验证了解耦答案提议与奖励分配的有效性。
idea_en: A label-free RLVR framework that decouples answer proposal from reward disposal, where votes from model rollouts propose candidate answers and a formal verifier determines reward allocation.

A ResZero (Residual-Zero) fallback reward mechanism that discards unverified plurality proposals and redistributes a zero-mean, variance-preserving signal over residual answers when formal verification is inconclusive.
A method of rewarding only rollouts matching the plurality-voted answer when that answer is successfully verified in a formal proof assistant (e.g., Lean), maintaining optimization stability.
A system that uses formal verification (e.g., Lean) as a ground-truth check for RLVR rewards, eliminating the need for human-annotated answers while avoiding false positives from LLM-based judges.
A training framework that achieves supervised-level pass@1 performance without ground-truth labels by combining plurality voting, formal verification, and residual zero-mean reward redistribution.
idea_ch: 一种无标签RLVR框架，将答案提议与奖励分配解耦：模型rollouts投票产生候选答案，形式验证器决定奖励分配。
ResZero（Residual-Zero）回退奖励机制：当形式验证不确定时，丢弃未经验证的多数提议，在剩余答案上重新分配零均值、方差保持的奖励信号。
一种仅在多数票答案通过Lean形式验证器验证时才奖励匹配该答案的rollouts的方法，保持优化稳定性。
利用Lean等形式验证器作为RLVR奖励的客观校验手段，消除人工标注需求并避免基于LLM评判的假阳性问题。

title: PI-TTA: Physics-Informed Source-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Human Activity Recognition on Mobile Devices
summary: Source-free test-time adaptation (TTA) is appealing for mobile and wearable sensing because it enables on-device personalization from unlabeled test streams without centralizing private data. However, sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) poses challenges that are less pronounced in standard vision benchmarks: behavioral inertial streams are temporally correlated and often exhibit within-session shifts caused by sensor rotation, placement change, and sampling-rate drift. Under this streaming non-i.i.d. setting, widely used vision-style TTA objectives can become unstable, leading to overconfident errors, representation collapse, and catastrophic forgetting. We propose PI-TTA, a lightweight source-free adaptation framework that stabilizes online updates through three physics-consistent constraints: gravity consistency, short-horizon temporal continuity, and spectral stability. PI-TTA updates the same small parameter subset as strong source-free baselines and incurs only modest overhead, making it suitable for on-device deployment. Experiments on USCHAD, PAMAP2, and mHealth under long-sequence stress tests and factorized shift protocols show that PI-TTA mitigates the severe degradation observed in confidence-driven baselines and preserves stable adaptation under sustained streaming conditions. It improves long-sequence accuracy by up to 9.13% and reduces physical-violation rates by 27.5%, 24.1%, and 45.4% on USCHAD, PAMAP2, and mHealth, respectively. These results demonstrate that physics-informed adaptation can improve accuracy, stability, and deployment reliability for real-world mobile sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PI-TTA，一个基于物理一致性约束的轻量级源无关测试时自适应框架，专门解决移动传感人体活动识别中非独立同分布流式数据带来的不稳定问题，通过重力一致性、短时时间连续性和频谱稳定性三个约束，在保持低计算开销的同时显著提升长期流式自适应稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的源无关测试时自适应方法多基于视觉任务设计，直接应用于传感器人体活动识别时面临三大挑战：惯性数据具有时间相关性，且存在传感器旋转、放置位置变化、采样率漂移等会话内偏移，导致流式非独立同分布场景下置信度驱动的目标函数不稳定、过度自信错误、表征坍塌和灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出三种物理一致性约束：1) 重力一致性约束，利用加速度计中重力分量在短时内应保持稳定的物理先验；2) 短时时间连续性约束，确保相邻时间步的特征表示平滑变化；3) 频谱稳定性约束，在频域维度维持传感器信号的稳定频谱分布。仅更新模型的小参数子集，保持与强基线相同的轻量级部署特性。
AI.result: 在USCHAD、PAMAP2和mHealth三个数据集上的长序列压力测试和分解偏移协议实验中，PI-TTA有效缓解了置信度驱动基线的严重退化，长序列准确率提升最高达9.13%，物理违背率分别降低27.5%、24.1%和45.4%。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息约束的自适应方法能够在准确性、稳定性和部署可靠性方面显著优于现有的视觉风格TTA方法，适用于真实世界的移动传感系统在线部署。
idea_en: A physics-consistent test-time adaptation method for inertial sensor data that enforces gravity vector consistency as a stabilizer for online model updates in HAR systems.
A short-horizon temporal continuity constraint mechanism that ensures smooth feature transitions between consecutive time steps in streaming sensor data adaptation.
A spectral stability constraint that maintains consistent frequency-domain distribution of sensor signals during online model adaptation to prevent catastrophic forgetting.
A lightweight source-free adaptation framework that updates only a small parameter subset while incorporating multiple physics priors for on-device deployment in mobile sensing.
A physics-informed regularization method that reduces physical-violation rates in human activity recognition by enforcing domain-specific physical constraints during test-time adaptation.

title: SciEval: A Benchmark for Automatic Evaluation of K-12 Science Instructional Materials
summary: The need to evaluate instructional materials for K-12 science education has become increasingly important, as more educators use generative AI to create instructional materials. However, the review of instructional materials is time-consuming, expertise-intensive, and difficult to scale, motivating interest in automated evaluation approaches. While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on general evaluation tasks, their performance and reliability on instructional materials remain unclear. To address this gap, we formulate Automatic Instructional Materials Evaluation (AIME) as a generative AI task that predicts scores and evidence using the rubric designed by the educator. We create a benchmark dataset and develop baseline models for AIME. First, we curate the first AIME dataset, SciEval, consisting of instructional materials annotated with pedagogy-aligned evaluation scores and evidence-based rationales. Expert annotations achieve high inter-rater reliability, resulting in a dataset of 273 lesson-level instructional materials evaluated across 13 criteria (N=3549) using the EQuIP rubric. Second, we test mainstream LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Llama, and Qwen) on SciEval and find that none achieve strong performance. Then we fine-tune Qwen3 on SciEval. Results on a held-out test set show that domain-aligned fine-tuning can achieve up to 11 percent performance gains, highlighting the importance of domain-specific fine-tuning for AIME and facilitating the use of LLMs in other educational tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自动教学内容评估（AIME）任务，构建了SciEval基准数据集，测试了主流LLM在该任务上的表现，发现通用模型表现不佳，而领域微调可获得高达11%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 随着教师越来越多使用生成式AI创建教学内容，对K-12科学教学材料的评估需求日益增长。但人工评审耗时、依赖专家且难以规模化，因此需要自动化评估方法。现有LLM在通用评估任务上表现良好，但在教学内容评估上的可靠性和性能尚不明确。
AI.method: 1. 定义自动教学内容评估（AIME）任务：基于教育者设计的评分标准，预测分数并生成证据。2. 构建SciEval数据集：包含273个课时级教学材料，依据EQuIP评分标准在13个维度上评估（N=3549），专家注释具有高信度。3. 测试主流LLM（GPT、Gemini、Llama、Qwen）并微调Qwen3。
AI.result: 主流LLM在SciEval上均未达到强表现。领域微调Qwen3后在测试集上获得高达11%的性能提升，表明领域专用微调对AIME任务的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用的微调是提升LLM在教学内容自动评估任务上性能的关键路径，该框架可推广至其他教育任务。
idea_en: A method for automatic evaluation of instructional materials using LLMs fine-tuned on pedagogy-aligned rubric datasets with evidence-based rationale generation.
A benchmark dataset (SciEval) for K-12 science instructional material evaluation, featuring multi-criteria scoring based on the EQuIP rubric with expert-annotated evidence.
A domain-specific fine-tuning framework (AIME) that adapts general LLMs to predict both scores and textual evidence for instructional material assessment.
A generative AI pipeline that takes instructional materials as input and outputs rubric-aligned evaluation scores with supporting evidence, trained on expert-annotated pedagogical data.

title: Improving Zero-Shot Offline RL via Behavioral Task Sampling
summary: Offline zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn agents that optimize unseen reward functions without additional environment interaction. The standard approach to this problem trains task-conditioned policies by sampling task vectors that define linear reward functions over learned state representations. In most existing algorithms, these task vectors are randomly sampled, implicitly assuming this adequately captures the structure of the task space. We argue that doing so leads to suboptimal zero-shot generalization. To address this limitation, we propose extracting task vectors directly from the offline dataset and using them to define the task distribution used for policy training. We introduce a simple and general reward function extraction procedure that integrates into existing offline zero-shot RL algorithms. Across multiple benchmark environments and baselines, our approach improves zero-shot performance by an average of 20%, highlighting the importance of principled task sampling in offline zero-shot RL.

AI.tldr: 提出从离线数据集中提取任务向量而非随机采样，以提升离线零样本强化学习的泛化性能，平均提升20%。
AI.motivation: 现有离线零样本强化学习方法随机采样任务向量，未能充分捕捉任务空间的结构，导致零样本泛化性能次优。
AI.method: 提出从离线数据集中直接提取奖励函数（任务向量）的通用方法，将其用于定义策略训练的任务分布，可集成到现有离线零样本RL算法中。
AI.result: 在多个基准环境和基线算法上，该方法平均提升零样本性能20%。
AI.conclusion: 强调了原则性的任务采样在离线零样本强化学习中的重要性，简单有效的奖励函数提取方法即可显著提升性能。
idea_en: A method for extracting task vectors directly from offline datasets to define task distribution for training task-conditioned policies in zero-shot RL
A reward function extraction procedure that integrates into existing offline zero-shot RL algorithms without requiring additional environment interaction
Principled task sampling approach that captures the true structure of the task space from offline data, replacing random task vector sampling

title: PHISHREV: A Hybrid Machine Learning and Post-Hoc Non-monotonic Reasoning Framework for Context-Aware Phishing Website Classification
summary: Phishing detection systems are predominantly rely on statistical machine learning models, which often lack contextual reasoning and are vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates machine learning classifiers with non-monotonic reasoning using Answer Set Programming (ASP) to enable context-aware decision refinement. The proposed post-hoc reasoning layer incorporates expert knowledge to revise classifier predictions through formal belief revisions. Experimental results indicate that the reasoning module modifies 5.08\% of classifier outputs, leading to improved decision consistency. A key advantage is that new domain knowledge can be incorporated into the reasoning layer in $\mathcal{O}(n)$ time, eliminating the need for model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合框架，将机器学习分类器与非单调推理（答案集编程ASP）相结合，通过后验推理层修正分类器预测结果，实验表明5.08%的输出被修改，且新知识可在O(n)时间内加入而无需重新训练模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的钓鱼检测系统主要依赖统计机器学习模型，缺乏上下文推理能力且易受对抗性操纵攻击。
AI.method: 提出混合框架：机器学习分类器 + 基于答案集编程(ASP)的非单调推理后处理层，通过形式化信念修正来修正分类器预测。
AI.result: 推理模块修正了5.08%的分类器输出，提升了决策一致性。
AI.conclusion: 新领域知识可在O(n)时间内集成到推理层，无需重新训练模型，具有良好的可扩展性和实用性。
idea_en: A hybrid phishing detection framework integrating machine learning classifiers with non-monotonic reasoning via Answer Set Programming (ASP) for context-aware decision refinement.
A post-hoc reasoning layer that revises classifier predictions through formal belief revision mechanisms based on expert knowledge.
A method for incorporating new domain knowledge into the reasoning layer in O(n) time without requiring model retraining.
A context-aware phishing detection system that improves decision consistency by modifying classifier outputs (5.08% modified) using formal reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种将机器学习分类器与基于答案集编程(ASP)的非单调推理相结合的混合钓鱼检测框架，实现上下文感知的决策优化。

title: Automated Adversarial Collaboration for Advancing Theory Building in the Cognitive Sciences
summary: Cognitive science often evaluates theories through narrow paradigms and local model comparisons, limiting the integration of evidence across tasks and realizations. We introduce an automated adversarial collaboration framework for adjudicating among competing theories even when the candidate models and experiments must be discovered during the adjudication process. The system combines LLM-based theory agents, program synthesis, and information-theoretic experimental design in a closed loop. In a simulation study spanning three classic categorization theories, the framework recovered the ground-truth theory across noise settings with weaker reliability in the hardest settings. Together, the framework and findings provide a concrete proof of concept for closed-loop, in-silico theory adjudication in cognitive science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自动化对抗性协作框架，结合LLM理论智能体、程序合成和信息论实验设计，在模拟中自动裁决三种经典分类理论，为认知科学中的闭环理论裁决提供了概念验证。
AI.motivation: 认知科学中的理论评估通常局限于狭窄范式和局部模型比较，难以整合跨任务和跨实现的证据。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化对抗性协作框架，结合基于LLM的理论智能体、程序合成和信息论实验设计，形成闭环系统，在模拟中自动发现候选模型和实验并裁决竞争理论。
AI.result: 在涵盖三种经典分类理论的模拟研究中，该框架能在不同噪声设置下恢复真实理论，但在最难设置下可靠性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为认知科学中闭环、计算机内理论裁决提供了概念验证。

title: Sample-efficient Neuro-symbolic Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms often require a large amount of data and struggle in sparse-reward domains with long planning horizons and multiple sub-goals. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic extension of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) that transfers partial logical policy specifications learned in easier instances to guide learning in more challenging settings. We introduce two integrations of symbolic guidance: (i) H-PPO-Product, which biases the action distribution at sampling time, and (ii) H-PPO-SymLoss, which augments the PPO loss with a symbolic regularization term. We evaluate our methods on three benchmarks (OfficeWorld, WaterWorld, and DoorKey), showing consistently faster learning and higher return at convergence than PPO and a Reward Machine baseline, also under imperfect symbolic knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出了神经符号扩展的PPO算法(H-PPO-Product和H-PPO-SymLoss)，通过在容易实例中学习部分逻辑策略规范来指导更难环境中的学习，在三个基准测试中比PPO和Reward Machine基线更快收敛且回报更高。
AI.motivation: DRL算法在稀疏奖励、长规划视野和多子目标的领域中需要大量数据且表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出了两种神经符号PPO扩展：(i) H-PPO-Product，在采样时通过逻辑策略规范偏置动作分布；(ii) H-PPO-SymLoss，在PPO损失函数中加入符号正则化项。从易到难迁移部分逻辑策略规范。
AI.result: 在OfficeWorld、WaterWorld和DoorKey三个基准测试上，比PPO和Reward Machine基线学习更快，收敛回报更高，且在符号知识不完美时仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法可以有效加速DRL在复杂稀疏奖励环境中的学习，且对不完美符号知识具有鲁棒性。

title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Understanding
summary: We introduce DualFact, a dual-layer, multimodal factuality evaluation framework for procedural video captioning. DualFact separates factual correctness into conceptual facts, capturing abstract semantic roles (e.g., Action, Ingredient, Tool, Location), and contextual facts, capturing their grounded predicate-argument realizations in video. To support complete and role-consistent evaluation, DualFact incorporates implicit argument augmentation (VIA) and contrastive fact sets. We instantiate DualFact in two modes: DualFact-T, which verifies facts against textual evidence, and DualFact-V, which verifies facts against video-grounded visual evidence. Experiments on YouCook3-Fact and CraftBench-Fact show that state-of-the-art multimodal language models produce fluent but often factually incomplete captions, with systematic omissions and role-level inconsistencies. DualFact correlates more strongly with human factuality judgments than standard metrics, particularly for contextual facts, and reveals that caption-only evaluation overestimates hallucinations compared to video-grounded verification. Overall, DualFact offers an interpretable and human-aligned evaluation protocol that highlights persistent challenges in multimodal factual grounding, extending beyond surface-level fluency.

AI.tldr: 提出了DualFact，一个用于过程性视频字幕的双层多模态事实性评估框架，将事实正确性分为概念事实和上下文事实，并引入隐式论元增强和对比事实集，实验表明比标准指标更符合人类事实性判断。
AI.motivation: 现有视频字幕评估指标关注流畅性而忽略事实正确性，尤其是过程性视频中涉及多个实体、动作和工具时，模型常产生看似流畅但事实不完整的字幕。
AI.method: DualFact将事实正确性分为概念事实（抽象语义角色）和上下文事实（接地谓词-论元实现），包含隐式论元增强(VIA)和对比事实集，支持两种模式：DualFact-T（文本证据）和DualFact-V（视频证据）。

AI.conclusion: DualFact提供了一个可解释且与人类对齐的评估协议，揭示了多模态事实接地中的持续挑战，超越了表面流畅性。

title: OxyGent: Making Multi-Agent Systems Modular, Observable, and Evolvable via Oxy Abstraction
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, ACL 2026 System Demonstration track
summary: Deploying production-ready multi-agent systems (MAS) in complex industrial environments remains challenging due to limitations in scalability, observability, and autonomous evolution. We present OxyGent, an open-source framework that enables modular, observable, and evolvable MAS via a unified Oxy abstraction, in which agents, tools, LLMs, and reasoning flows are encapsulated as pluggable atomic components. This Lego-like assembly paradigm supports scalable system composition and non-intrusive monitoring. To enhance observability, OxyGent introduces permission-driven dynamic planning that replaces rigid workflows with execution graphs generated at runtime, which provide adaptive visualizations. To support continuous evolution, the framework integrates OxyBank, an AI asset management platform that supports automated data backflow, annotation, and joint evolution. Empirical evaluations and real-world case studies show that OxyGent provides a robust and scalable foundation for MAS. OxyGent is publicly available at https://oxygent.jd.com/.

AI.result: 实证评估和真实案例表明OxyGent提供了鲁棒且可扩展的MAS基础。
AI.conclusion: OxyGent框架有效解决了生产级MAS中的可扩展性、可观测性和自主演化问题。

title: The Nonverbal Syntax Framework: An Evidence-Based Tiered System for Inferring Learner States from Observable Behavioral Cues
summary: Understanding learners' cognitive and affective states underpins adaptive educational systems and effective teaching. Although research links nonverbal cues to internal states, no framework calibrates them to evidence. We present the Nonverbal Syntax Framework, drawn from a systematic review of 908 studies and 17,043 cue-state mappings (Turaev et al., 2026). The framework addresses three challenges: terminological fragmentation (behaviors described inconsistently), evidence heterogeneity (single observations to replicated findings), and state ambiguity (similar patterns indicating multiple states). Normalization consolidated 5,537 state labels into 2,010 canonical states (63.7%) and 11,521 cues into 6,434 normalized cues (44.2%) across nine behavioral channels. Dual-evidence assessment separately evaluates Component Evidence (coverage of cues and states) and Relationship Evidence (independent studies per cue-state link). 52% of "Very High" relationships rest on one paper, so separation enables calibrated rather than overconfident inference from preliminary findings. The framework's four levels comprise a Cue Vocabulary of 6,434 indicators classified as observable/instrumental; State Clusters linking 2,010 states to indicative cues; State Profiles with multimodal behavioral signatures and actionable specifications; and Discriminative Analysis distinguishing 1,215 confusable state pairs. We identify 480 actionable R1-R4 relationships (three or more independent papers), the replicated core of six decades of research, covering 35.5% of mappings across 47 key learning states and 111 distinct indicators. The remaining 91.5% (9,653 single-paper findings) form exploratory hypotheses for replication. The framework gives researchers an empirical foundation for identifying gaps, practitioners evidence-based tools for state inference, and technologists validated features for multimodal detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非语言句法框架（Nonverbal Syntax Framework），基于908项研究和17,043条线索-状态映射的系统综述，解决了术语碎片化、证据异质性和状态模糊性三大挑战。通过对状态标签和线索的归一化处理，以及双重证据评估，建立了包含线索词汇、状态簇、状态画像和判别分析的四级框架，识别出480条可操作的高置信度关系。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏一个能够将非语言线索与学习者的认知和情感状态进行校准的实证框架，现有研究存在术语描述不一致、证据类型差异大、以及相似行为模式对应多种状态等问题。
AI.method: 对908项研究、17,043条线索-状态映射进行系统综述；将5,537个状态标签归一化为2,010个规范状态，将11,521个线索归一化为6,434个规范线索；采用双重证据评估（组件证据和关系证据）分别评估；构建四级框架：线索词汇、状态簇、状态画像、判别分析。
AI.result: 识别出480条R1-R4关系（基于三篇或以上独立论文），覆盖35.5%的映射，涉及47个关键学习状态和111个不同指标；其余91.5%的9,653条单篇论文发现形成探索性假设；52%的"极高"关系基于单篇论文。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究人员识别研究空白、从业者进行状态推理、技术人员开发多模态检测系统提供了基于实证的基础工具。

title: HotComment: A Benchmark for Evaluating Popularity of Online Comments
summary: Online comments play a crucial role in shaping public sentiment and opinion dynamics on social media. However, evaluating their popularity remains challenging, not only because it depends on linguistic quality, originality, and emotional resonance, but also because stylistic preferences vary widely across platforms and user groups, causing the same comment to resonate differently in different communities. In this work, we present HotComment, a multimodal benchmark integrating video and text modalities that comprehensively quantifies popularity from three enhanced aspects: (1) Content Quality, which evaluates semantic similarity with ground-truth human comments and extends quality assessment through four interpretable dimensions; (2) Popularity Prediction, based on trends from models trained on real-world interaction data; and (3) User Behavior Simulation, which models the distribution of platform users and approximates \textbf{engagement scores} through an agent-based framework. Furthermore, we propose StyleCmt, inspired by social ripple effects, where multiple stylistic dimensions align to amplify socially resonant expressions and suppress incongruent ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HotComment多模态基准（视频+文本），从内容质量、流行度预测、用户行为模拟三个维度量化评论流行度，并提出StyleCmt模型，通过多风格维度对齐放大社会共鸣表达、抑制不协调表达。
AI.motivation: 在线评论的流行度评估面临挑战，因为不仅取决于语言质量、原创性和情感共鸣，而且风格偏好在不同平台和用户群体间差异巨大，导致同一评论在不同社区反响各异。
AI.method: 提出HotComment多模态基准：1) 内容质量：语义相似度评估+四个可解释维度；2) 流行度预测：基于真实交互数据训练的模型趋势；3) 用户行为模拟：基于智能体的框架建模用户分布并近似参与度分数。提出StyleCmt模型，受社会涟漪效应启发，对齐多风格维度以放大社会共鸣表达，抑制不协调表达。
AI.result: 构建了整合视频和文本的多模态基准HotComment，从三个增强角度量化评论流行度，并提出了StyleCmt模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过多模态融合和社会涟漪效应机制，提升了评论流行度评估的全面性和准确性。
