title: Think Before You Act -- A Neurocognitive Governance Model for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: The rapid deployment of autonomous AI agents across enterprise, healthcare, and safety-critical environments has created a fundamental governance gap. Existing approaches, runtime guardrails, training-time alignment, and post-hoc auditing treat governance as an external constraint rather than an internalized behavioral principle, leaving agents vulnerable to unsafe and irreversible actions. We address this gap by drawing on how humans self-govern naturally: before acting, humans engage deliberate cognitive processes grounded in executive function, inhibitory control, and internalized organizational rules to evaluate whether an intended action is permissible, requires modification, or demands escalation. This paper proposes a neurocognitive governance framework that formally maps this human self-governance process to LLM-driven agent reasoning, establishing a structural parallel between the human brain and the large language model as the cognitive core of an agent. We formalize a Pre-Action Governance Reasoning Loop (PAGRL) in which agents consult a four-layer governance rule set: global, workflow-specific, agent-specific, and situational before every consequential action, mirroring how human organizations structure compliance hierarchies across enterprise, department, and role levels. Implemented on a production-grade retail supply chain workflow, the framework achieves 95% compliance accuracy and zero false escalations to human oversight, demonstrating that embedding governance into agent reasoning produces more consistent, explainable, and auditable compliance than external enforcement. This work offers a principled foundation for autonomous AI agents that govern themselves the way humans do: not because rules are imposed upon them, but because deliberation is embedded in how they think.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经认知治理框架，将人类自我治理的认知过程（执行功能、抑制控制、内化组织规则）映射到LLM驱动的AI智能体推理中，通过预行动治理推理循环（PAGRL）和四层治理规则集，在生产级零售供应链工作流中实现95%合规准确率和零误报升级。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体治理方法（运行时护栏、训练时对齐、事后审计）将治理视为外部约束而非内化的行为原则，导致智能体容易执行不安全且不可逆的操作，存在根本性的治理鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 建立人脑与LLM之间的结构平行映射；2) 提出预行动治理推理循环（PAGRL），在每次重要行动前执行治理检查；3) 设计四层治理规则集（全局级、工作流级、智能体级、情境级）；4) 将治理推理嵌入智能体认知过程而非外部施加。

title: RADD: Retrieval-Augmented Discrete Diffusion for Multi-Modal Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Most multi-modal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC) models use one embedding scorer to do both retrieval over the full entity set and final decision making. We argue that this coupling is a core bottleneck: global high-recall search and local fine-grained disambiguation require different inductive biases. Therefore, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Discrete Diffusion (RADD) framework to decouple retrieve and reranking for MMKGC. A relation-aware multimodal KGE retriever serves as both global retriever and distillation teacher, while a conditional discrete denoiser performs shortlist-level entity-identity generation for reranking. Training combines KGE supervision, denoising cross-entropy, and temperature-scaled distillation from the retriever to the denoiser. At inference, the designed Diff-Rerank first forms a top-$K$ shortlist with the retriever and then reranks it with the denoiser, ensuring that recall is a strict prerequisite for precision. Experiments on three MMKGC benchmarks show that RADD achieves the best performance and consistent gains over strong unimodal, multimodal, and LLM-based baselines, while ablations further verify the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出RADD框架，将多模态知识图谱补全中的检索与重排序解耦，通过检索增强离散扩散方法实现全局检索和局部细粒度消歧的分离，在三个基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MMKGC模型使用一个嵌入评分器同时负责全实体集检索和最终决策，这种耦合机制导致全局高召回检索与局部细粒度消歧所需的不同归纳偏置之间存在冲突，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出RADD框架：(1) 关系感知多模态KGE检索器作为全局检索器和蒸馏教师；(2) 条件离散去噪器执行候选级实体身份生成用于重排序；(3) 训练结合KGE监督、去噪交叉熵和温度缩放的蒸馏损失；(4) 推理阶段用Diff-Rerank先构建top-K候选列表再用去噪器重排序。
AI.result: 在三个MMKGC基准数据集上达到最佳性能，一致性地优于强单模态、多模态和基于LLM的基线方法，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将检索与重排序解耦能有效解决MMKGC中全局召回与局部消歧的权衡问题，离散扩散模型在实体身份生成重排序方面具有优势。

title: Scalable Inference Architectures for Compound AI Systems: A Production Deployment Study
comment: Accepted to the ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems (ACM CAIS 2026)
summary: Modern enterprise AI applications increasingly rely on compound AI systems - architectures that compose multiple models, retrievers, and tools to accomplish complex tasks. Deploying such systems in production demands inference infrastructure that can efficiently serve concurrent, heterogeneous model invocations while maintaining cost-effectiveness and low latency. This paper presents a production deployment study of a modular, platform-agnostic inference architecture developed at Salesforce to support compound AI use cases including Agentforce (autonomous AI agents) and ApexGuru (AI-powered code analysis). The system integrates serverless execution, dynamic autoscaling, and MLOps pipelines to deliver consistent low-latency inference across multi-component agent workflows. We report production results demonstrating over 50% reduction in tail latency (P95), up to 3.9x throughput improvement, and 30 to 40% cost savings compared to prior static deployments. We further present a novel analysis of compound-system-specific challenges including multi-model fan-out overhead, cascading cold-start propagation, and heterogeneous scaling dynamics that emerge uniquely when serving agentic workloads. Through detailed case studies and operational lessons, we illustrate how the architecture enables compound AI systems to scale model invocations in parallel, handle bursty multi-agent workloads, and support rapid model iteration - capabilities essential for operationalizing agentic AI at enterprise scale.

AI.tldr: Salesforce提出了一种模块化、平台无关的推理架构，通过无服务器执行、动态自动扩缩容和MLOps管道，支持复合AI系统（如Agentforce和ApexGuru）的生产部署，实现了P95尾延迟降低50%以上、吞吐量提升3.9倍、成本节省30-40%。
AI.motivation: 现代企业AI应用依赖复合AI系统（多模型+检索器+工具组合），但生产部署面临并发异构模型调用、成本与延迟平衡等挑战，传统静态部署无法满足需求。
AI.method: 采用模块化平台无关架构，集成无服务器执行（serverless）、动态自动扩缩容（dynamic autoscaling）和MLOps管道，针对多组件智能体工作流优化推理基础设施，支持并行模型调用和突发工作负载处理。
AI.result: 相比静态部署：P95尾延迟降低50%以上，吞吐量提升3.9倍，成本节省30-40%。揭示了多模型扇出开销、级联冷启动传播、异构扩缩容动力学等复合系统特有挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该架构通过并行化模型调用、处理突发多智能体工作负载、支持快速模型迭代，有效实现了企业级智能体AI的规模化运营。

title: Toward Scalable Terminal Task Synthesis via Skill Graphs
summary: Terminal agents have demonstrated strong potential for autonomous command-line execution, yet their training remains constrained by the scarcity of high-quality and diverse execution trajectories. Existing approaches mitigate this bottleneck by synthesizing large-scale terminal task instances for trajectory sampling. However, they primarily focus on scaling the number of tasks while providing limited control over the diversity of execution trajectories that agents actually experience during training. In this paper, we present SkillSynth, an automated framework for terminal task synthesis built on a scenario-mediated skill graph. SkillSynth first constructs a large-scale skill graph, where scenarios serve as intermediate transition nodes that connect diverse command-line skills. It then samples paths from this graph as abstractions of real-world workflows, and uses a multi-agent harness to instantiate them into executable task instances. By grounding task synthesis in graph-sampled workflow paths, SkillSynth explicitly controls the diversity of minimal execution trajectories required to solve the synthesized tasks. Experiments on Terminal-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of SkillSynth. Moreover, task instances synthesized by SkillSynth have been adopted to train Hy3 Preview, contributing to its enhanced agentic capabilities in terminal-based settings.

AI.tldr: SkillSynth是一个自动化框架，通过场景中介的技能图来合成多样化的终端任务实例，用于训练终端智能体，有效提升了执行轨迹的多样性控制。
AI.motivation: 现有终端智能体训练受限于高质量、多样化执行轨迹的稀缺性，现有方法虽能合成大规模任务，但对训练过程中智能体实际经历的轨迹多样性控制有限。

AI.result: Terminal-Bench实验验证了SkillSynth的有效性；合成的任务实例已被用于训练Hy3 Preview，并增强了其基于终端的智能体能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务合成锚定在图采样的工作流路径上，SkillSynth能够显式控制解决合成任务所需的最小执行轨迹的多样性，从而提升终端智能体训练效果。

title: QAROO: AI-Driven Online Task Offloading for Energy-Efficient and Sustainable MEC Networks
summary: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) and intelligent science, intelligent edge computing has been widely adopted. However, the limitations of traditional methods, such as poor adaptability and the slow convergence of heuristic algorithms, are becoming increasingly evident. To enable sustainable and resource-efficient edge applications, this paper proposes an online task offloading framework for wireless powered mobile edge computing (MEC) networks, called Quantum Attention-based Reinforcement learning for Online Offloading (QAROO). The system employs a binary offloading strategy with the aim of co-optimizing computing and energy resources in dynamic channel environments. In response to the issues of poor adaptability in traditional approaches and the slow convergence of heuristic algorithms, the framework integrates quantum neural networks and attention mechanisms, introducing three key improvements: using recurrent neural networks to enhance temporal modeling capability, proposing an uncertainty-guided quantization method to improve exploration efficiency, and incorporating attention mechanisms into quantum networks to strengthen feature representation. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms comparative schemes in terms of normalized computation speed and processing time, offering an efficient and stable solution for online task offloading in large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于量子注意力强化学习（QAROO）的在线任务卸载框架，用于无线供能移动边缘计算网络，通过融合量子神经网络、注意力机制和循环神经网络，实现动态信道环境下计算与能源资源的协同优化。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在智能边缘计算中适应性差，启发式算法收敛速度慢，难以满足动态环境下大规模物联网的高效在线任务卸载需求。
AI.method: 提出QAROO框架：1）采用二进制卸载策略；2）融合量子神经网络与注意力机制；3）用循环神经网络增强时序建模；4）提出不确定性引导的量化方法提升探索效率；5）将注意力机制引入量子网络增强特征表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在归一化计算速度和处理时间上优于对比方案，为大规模物联网动态环境提供了高效稳定的在线任务卸载方案。
AI.conclusion: QAROO框架有效解决了传统方法适应性差和启发式算法收敛慢的问题，实现了可持续、资源高效的边缘计算应用。

title: StratFormer: Adaptive Opponent Modeling and Exploitation in Imperfect-Information Games
summary: We present StratFormer, a transformer-based meta-agent that learns to simultaneously model and exploit opponents in imperfect-information games through a two-phase curriculum. The first phase trains an opponent modeling head to identify behavioral patterns from action histories while the agent plays a game-theoretic optimal (GTO) policy. The second phase progressively shifts the policy toward best-response (BR) exploitation, guided by a per-opponent regularization schedule tied to exploitability. Our architecture introduces dual-turn tokens -- feature vectors constructed at both agent and opponent decision points -- coupled with bucket-rate features that encode opponent tendencies across five strategic contexts. On Leduc Hold'em, a small poker variant with six cards and two betting rounds, we test against six opponent archetypes at two strength levels each, with exploitability ranging from 0.15 to 1.26 Big Blinds (BB) per hand. StratFormer achieves an average exploitation gain of +0.106 BB per hand over GTO, with peak gains of +0.821 against highly exploitable opponents, while maintaining near-equilibrium safety.

AI.tldr: StratFormer是一种基于Transformer的元智能体，通过两阶段课程学习在非完美信息游戏中同时建模和利用对手，在Leduc Hold'em上相比GTO平均每手获利+0.106 BB，峰值达+0.821 BB。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么过于保守（仅使用GTO策略），要么过度利用对手而面临被反利用的风险。缺乏一种能在安全性和利用性之间取得平衡的自适应框架。
AI.method: 提出两阶段课程学习：第一阶段训练对手建模头，同时智能体执行GTO策略；第二阶段逐步向最佳响应（BR）利用策略迁移，通过基于可开发性的逐对手正则化调度控制利用程度。引入双回合令牌（在智能体和对手决策点构建特征向量）和桶率特征（编码五种战略上下文中的对手倾向）。
AI.result: 在Leduc Hold'em上测试六种对手原型各两个强度级别（可开发性0.15-1.26 BB/手）。平均利用增益+0.106 BB/手，面对高可开发对手峰值+0.821 BB/手，同时保持近均衡安全性。
AI.conclusion: StratFormer在非完美信息游戏中成功实现了安全性与利用性的平衡，通过结构化课程和可开发性导向的正则化，在保证近均衡安全的前提下有效利用对手漏洞。

A dual-turn token architecture that constructs feature vectors at both agent and opponent decision points within a transformer framework to capture sequential interaction patterns.

A meta-agent transformer structure that simultaneously maintains both opponent modeling and game-theoretic optimal policy heads with controlled exploitation switching mechanism.

title: TrialCalibre: A Fully Automated Causal Engine for RCT Benchmarking and Observational Trial Calibration
summary: Real-world evidence (RWE) studies that emulate target trials increasingly inform regulatory and clinical decisions, yet residual, hard-to-quantify biases still limit their credibility. The recently proposed BenchExCal framework addresses this challenge via a two-stage Benchmark, Expand, Calibrate process, which first compares an observational emulation against an existing randomized controlled trial (RCT), then uses observed divergence to calibrate a second emulation for a new indication causal effect estimation. While methodologically powerful, BenchExCal is resource intensive and difficult to scale. We introduce TrialCalibre, a conceptualized multiagent system designed to automate and scale the BenchExCal workflow. Our framework features specialized agents such as the Orchestrator, Protocol Design, Data Synthesis, Clinical Validation, and Quantitative Calibration Agents that coordi-nate the the overall process. TrialCalibre incorpo-rates agent learning (e.g., RLHF) and knowledge blackboards to support adaptive, auditable, and transparent causal effect estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrialCalibre，一个基于多智能体系统的自动化框架，用于规模化执行BenchExCal因果效应校准流程，通过协调多个专业智能体实现从基准对比到校准估计的全流程自动化。
AI.motivation: 真实世界证据研究在模拟目标试验时存在残余的、难以量化的偏差，限制了其可信度。尽管BenchExCal框架通过基准-扩展-校准流程解决了这一问题，但该方法资源密集且难以规模化扩展。

title: Action-Aware Generative Sequence Modeling for Short Video Recommendation
summary: With the rapid development of the Internet, users have increasingly higher expectations for the recommendation accuracy of online content consumption platforms. However, short videos often contain diverse segments, and users may not hold the same attitude toward all of them. Traditional binary-classification recommendation models, which treat a video as a single holistic entity, face limitations in accurately capturing such nuanced preferences. Considering that user consumption is a temporal process, this paper demonstrates that the timing of user actions can represent diverse intentions through statistical analysis and examination of action patterns. Based on this insight, we propose a novel modeling paradigm: Action-Aware Generative Sequence Network (A2Gen), which refines user actions along the temporal dimension and chains them into sequences for unified processing and prediction. First, we introduce the Context-aware Attention Module (CAM) to model action sequences enriched with item-specific contextual features. Building upon this, we develop the Hierarchical Sequence Encoder (HSE) to learn temporal action patterns from users' historical actions. Finally, through leveraging CAM, we design a module for action sequence generation: the Action-seq Autoregressive Generator (AAG). Extensive offline experiments on the Kuaishou's dataset and the Tmall public dataset demonstrate the superiority of our proposed model. Furthermore, through large-scale online A/B testing deployed on Kuaishou's platform, our model achieves significant improvements over baseline methods in multi-task prediction by leveraging sequential information. Specifically, it yields increases of 0.34% in user watch time, 8.1% in interaction rate, and 0.162% in overall user retention (LifeTime-7), leading to successful deployment across all traffic, serving over 400 million users every day.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动作感知生成序列网络（A2Gen），通过细化用户行为的时间维度并构建行为序列，实现了对短视频推荐中用户细粒度偏好的精准建模，在快手和天猫数据集上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统二分类推荐模型将视频视为整体，无法捕捉用户对短视频中不同片段的多样化偏好，且忽略了用户行为的时间动态特性。
AI.method: 提出A2Gen框架：1) 上下文感知注意力模块(CAM)对行为序列建模物品级上下文特征；2) 层次序列编码器(HSE)学习时间行为模式；3) 行为序列自回归生成器(AAG)生成行为序列。
AI.result: 在快手和天猫数据集上离线实验表现优越；线上A/B测试中，观看时长提升0.34%，互动率提升8.1%，用户留存(LifeTime-7)提升0.162%，已部署覆盖4亿+日活用户。
AI.conclusion: 通过将用户行为按时间维度细化为序列进行统一建模，能更准确捕捉用户多样化意图，显著提升推荐系统的多任务预测性能。

A Context-aware Attention Module (CAM) that enriches action sequences with item-specific contextual features for improved recommendation accuracy.
A Hierarchical Sequence Encoder (HSE) that learns temporal action patterns from users' historical behavior sequences.
An Action-seq Autoregressive Generator (AAG) that generates user action sequences leveraging context-aware attention for predictive modeling.
A system for multi-task prediction in video recommendation that jointly optimizes watch time, interaction rate, and user retention using sequential action information.

title: Semi-Markov Reinforcement Learning for City-Scale EV Ride-Hailing with Feasibility-Guaranteed Actions
summary: We study city-scale control of electric-vehicle (EV) ride-hailing fleets where dispatch, repositioning, and charging decisions must respect charger and feeder limits under uncertain, spatially correlated demand and travel times. We formulate the problem as a hex-grid semi-Markov decision process (semi-MDP) with mixed actions -- discrete actions for serving, repositioning, and charging, together with continuous charging power -- and variable action durations. To guarantee physical feasibility during both training and deployment, the policy learns over high-level intentions produced by a masked, temperature-annealed actor. These intentions are projected at every decision step through a time-limited rolling mixed-integer linear program (MILP) that strictly enforces state-of-charge, port, and feeder constraints. To mitigate distributional shifts, we optimize a Soft Actor--Critic (SAC) agent against a Wasserstein-1 ambiguity set with a graph-aligned Mahalanobis ground metric that captures spatial correlations. The robust backup uses the Kantorovich--Rubinstein dual, a projected subgradient inner loop, and a primal--dual risk-budget update. Our architecture combines a two-layer Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) encoder, twin critics, and a value network that drives the adversary. Experiments on a large-scale EV fleet simulator built from NYC taxi data show that PD--RSAC achieves the highest net profit, reaching \$1.22M, compared with \$0.58M--\$0.70M for strong heuristic, single-agent RL, and multi-agent RL baselines, including Greedy, SAC, MAPPO, and MADDPG, while maintaining zero feeder-limit violations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合分层强化学习与鲁棒优化的城市级电动汽车网约车队控制方法（PD-RSAC），通过掩码温度退火Actor生成高层意图，再由滚动混合整数线性规划（MILP）进行物理可行投影，并利用Wasserstein-1模糊集和图对齐马氏距离实现分布式鲁棒优化，在纽约出租车数据大规模仿真中实现最高净利润122万美元且零馈线违规。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车网约车队的调度、重新定位和充电决策必须同时满足充电桩容量和馈线限制，而需求与旅行时间具有不确定性和空间相关性，现有方法难以同时保证物理可行性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 1. 将问题建模为六边形网格半马尔可夫决策过程（semi-MDP），包含离散动作（服务、重定位、充电）和连续充电功率的混合动作空间；2. 使用掩码温度退火Actor学习高层意图；3. 通过时间有限的滚动混合整数线性规划（MILP）投影，严格执行电量、充电端口和馈线约束；4. 基于Wasserstein-1模糊集和图对齐马氏距离的地面度量进行分布式鲁棒SAC优化；5. 使用Kantorovich-Rubinstein对偶、投影次梯度内循环和原对偶风险预算更新实现鲁棒备份；6. 架构包含两层图卷积网络（GCN）编码器、双评论家和驱动对抗者的价值网络。
AI.result: 在基于纽约出租车数据的大规模仿真中，PD-RSAC实现净利润122万美元，显著优于贪婪策略、SAC、MAPPO、MADDPG等基线（58万-70万美元），且保持零馈线违规。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了将强化学习与滚动MILP投影、分布式鲁棒优化相结合，是解决城市级EV车队控制这一复杂约束优化问题的有效范式，在经济效益和约束满足方面均显著优于现有方法。

title: ADEMA: A Knowledge-State Orchestration Architecture for Long-Horizon Knowledge Synthesis with LLMAgents
summary: Long-horizon LLM tasks often fail not because a single answer is unattainable, but because knowledge states drift across rounds, intermediate commitments remain implicit, and interruption fractures the evolving evidence chain. This paper presents ADEMA as a knowledge-state orchestration architecture for long-horizon knowledge synthesis rather than as a generic multi-agent runtime. The architecture combines explicit epistemic bookkeeping, heterogeneous dual-evaluator governance, adaptive task-mode switching, reputation-shaped resource allocation, checkpoint-resumable persistence, segment-level memory condensation, artifact-first assembly, and final-validity checking with safe fallback. Evidence is drawn entirely from existing materials: a four-scenario showcase package, a fixed 60-run mechanism matrix, targeted micro-ablation and artifact-chain supplements, and a repaired protocol-level benchmark in which code-oriented evaluation is the clearest quality-sensitive mechanism block. Across the fixed matrix, removing checkpoint/resume produced the only invalid run, and it did so in the interruption-sensitive resume condition. By contrast, dual evaluation, segment synthesis, and dynamic governance are best interpreted as supporting control mechanisms that shape trajectory discipline, explicit artifact progression, and cost-quality behavior rather than as universal binary prerequisites for completion. The contribution is therefore a knowledge-state orchestration architecture in which explicit epistemic state transition, evidence-bearing artifact progression, and recoverable continuity are the primary design commitments.

AI.tldr: ADEMA是一种面向长时域LLM任务的知识状态编排架构，通过显式认识论记账、双评估者治理、自适应任务切换、声誉资源分配、检查点恢复、片段级记忆压缩、工件优先组装和最终有效性检查等机制，解决知识漂移、中间承诺隐式和中断导致证据链断裂等问题。
AI.motivation: 长时域LLM任务常因知识状态随轮次漂移、中间承诺未被显式化、中断导致证据链断裂而失败，现有方法缺乏系统性的知识状态编排机制。
AI.method: 提出ADEMA架构，包含8项核心机制：显式认识论记账、异构双评估者治理、自适应任务模式切换、声誉形塑的资源分配、可检查点恢复的持久化、片段级记忆压缩、工件优先组装、最终有效性检查与安全回退。
AI.result: 在固定60次运行机制矩阵中，移除检查点/恢复功能是唯一导致无效运行的情况（在中断敏感的恢复条件下）。双评估、片段合成和动态治理被验证为支持性控制机制。
AI.conclusion: 核心贡献是知识状态编排架构，其中显式认识论状态转换、证据承载工件进展和可恢复连续性为关键设计承诺。
idea_en: A knowledge-state orchestration architecture for long-horizon LLM tasks with explicit epistemic bookkeeping that tracks and records knowledge state transitions across multiple reasoning rounds.
A heterogeneous dual-evaluator governance mechanism where two different types of evaluators assess intermediate knowledge states to ensure quality control.
A checkpoint-resumable persistence system that enables recovery of interrupted long-horizon LLM reasoning chains without losing progress.
A reputation-shaped resource allocation mechanism that dynamically allocates computational resources based on the reputation score of different knowledge paths.
A segment-level memory condensation technique that compresses intermediate knowledge segments into compact representations for efficient storage.
An artifact-first assembly method that prioritizes evidence-bearing artifacts as primary units for constructing final knowledge synthesis outputs.
A final-validity checking with safe fallback mechanism that verifies final outputs and provides alternative solutions when validation fails.

title: Recursive Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Recursive or looped language models have recently emerged as a new scaling axis by iteratively refining the same model computation over latent states to deepen reasoning. We extend such scaling principle from a single model to multi-agent systems, and ask: Can agent collaboration itself be scaled through recursion? To this end, we introduce RecursiveMAS, a recursive multi-agent framework that casts the entire system as a unified latent-space recursive computation. RecursiveMAS connects heterogeneous agents as a collaboration loop through the lightweight RecursiveLink module, enabling in-distribution latent thoughts generation and cross-agent latent state transfer. To optimize our framework, we develop an inner-outer loop learning algorithm for iterative whole-system co-optimization through shared gradient-based credit assignment across recursion rounds. Theoretical analyses of runtime complexity and learning dynamics establish that RecursiveMAS is more efficient than standard text-based MAS and maintains stable gradients during recursive training. Empirically, we instantiate RecursiveMAS under 4 representative agent collaboration patterns and evaluate across 9 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, search, and code generation. In comparison with advanced single/multi-agent and recursive computation baselines, RecursiveMAS consistently delivers an average accuracy improvement of 8.3%, together with 1.2$\times$-2.4$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and 34.6%-75.6% token usage reduction. Code and Data are provided in https://recursivemas.github.io.

AI.tldr: RecursiveMAS提出了一种递归多智能体框架，将整个多智能体协作系统建模为统一的隐空间递归计算，通过轻量级RecursiveLink模块实现异构智能体间的隐状态传递，并采用内外环学习算法进行联合优化，在9个基准测试中相比基线方法平均提升8.3%准确率，同时实现1.2-2.4倍推理加速和34.6%-75.6%的token节约。
AI.motivation: 将递归/循环语言模型从单一模型扩展到多智能体系统，探索智能体协作本身是否可以通过递归方式进行扩展，以解决现有文本交互式多智能体系统效率低、token消耗大的问题。
AI.method: 提出RecursiveMAS框架：(1) RecursiveLink模块实现智能体间隐状态传递；(2) 将整个系统建模为隐空间递归计算；(3) 内外环学习算法实现跨递归轮次的梯度共享端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、医学、搜索和代码生成等9个基准测试中，相比单/多智能体及递归计算基线方法，平均准确率提升8.3%，推理速度提升1.2-2.4倍，token消耗减少34.6%-75.6%。
AI.conclusion: 递归多智能体协作是一种有效的扩展方式，RecursiveMAS通过隐空间递归计算实现了更高效、更稳定的多智能体协作系统。
idea_en: A recursive multi-agent framework (RecursiveMAS) where heterogeneous agents are connected via a lightweight RecursiveLink module for cross-agent latent state transfer in a unified latent-space recursive computation loop.
An inner-outer loop co-optimization algorithm for recursive multi-agent systems that performs shared gradient-based credit assignment across recursion rounds for whole-system optimization.
A method for in-distribution latent thoughts generation within the recursive multi-agent loop, avoiding the token inefficiency of natural text-based inter-agent communication.
A technique for extending recursive/looped language model scaling from single model to multi-agent systems by treating the entire agent collaboration as a unified recursive computation process.
